units.text: IT之家 10 月 12 日消息，苹果公司大中华区董事总经理葛越今日分享，苹果公司首席运营官 Sabih Khan（萨比赫 · 汗）到访郑州，与郑州富士康员工进行交流。
萨比赫 · 汗还到访了裕同科技。据介绍，双方通过共同努力，实现了从所有苹果产品包装中移除塑料的目标。
另据河南日报消息，10 月 11 日，萨比赫 · 汗与富士康科技集团轮值 CEO、事业群总经理蒋集恒走进富士康郑州综保园区，查看应用于生产线和苹果手机的“黑科技”，并现场上手了一台 iPhone Duo 折叠屏手机。
IT之家获悉，2025 年底，富士康与郑州航空港区管委会国资平台合资成立河南鸿创科技有限公司。这是富士康在郑州的首家国企合资企业，注册资本 20 亿元，专注高端电子元器件研发与制造，今年 7 月投产，首期产值累计可达 1000 亿元。
“河南鸿创攻克溅镀制程，已应用到 iPhone 18 Pro 系列和 iPhone Duo 生产中。”蒋集恒介绍，业界首创将电磁屏蔽溅镀工艺直接应用于 SoC 封装表面，替代传统金属屏蔽罩，使模组厚度缩减 20%，并显著提升散热效能。

evidence.discovery_title: Apple and Epic clash over document production in latest App Store court filing
evidence.raw_lead: Epic Games is accusing Apple of "manufacturing" a pause in the legal proceedings over its proposed new App Store commission rates. Apple disagrees.
evidence.title: Apple and Epic clash over document production in latest App Store court filing - 9to5Mac

units.text: Epic Games is accusing Apple of “manufacturing” a pause in the legal proceedings over its proposed new App Store commission rates. Apple disagrees. Here are the details.
In a joint status update, Epic Games and Apple present very different accounts of Apple’s efforts to turn over internal documents explaining how it arrived at its proposed App Store commission rates.
A bit of context
As a reminder, in August, Apple proposed a new commission structure for purchases made through external App Store links.

Under the proposed structure, developers would pay commissions ranging from 5% to 15%, down from the 27% fee Apple introduced in 2024 after a court ordered the company to allow developers to direct users to alternative payment methods.

The court later found Apple in contempt of its order, a designation Apple is seeking to overturn before the Supreme Court, arguing that the order never forbade it from charging any commissions at all.

While the Supreme Court considers Apple’s challenge to the contempt ruling, a lower court is separately examining whether Apple can impose commissions on purchases made through external links, and if so, how much it can charge.
Apple recently tried to pause those proceedings until the Supreme Court reached a decision, but its requests were rejected by both the lower court and the Supreme Court.
As part of that process, Apple submitted its proposed 5% to 15% commission structure in August, along with evidence supporting those rates.
Under the agreement governing the proceedings, Apple was also required to hand over internal documents showing how it arrived at those rates.
The documents are meant to give Epic an opportunity to examine the basis for Apple’s proposed fees before formally responding to the court.
That’s where the latest dispute comes in, with Epic accusing Apple of deliberately delaying the proceedings and Apple rejecting those allegations.
Apple and Epic dispute evidence behind proposed App Store fees

In the joint status filing, Epic says that “[n]early two months after its production deadline, Apple has scarcely produced any documents,” adding that “Apple’s […] continued unwillingness to commit to a date certain by which it will complete its production demonstrates that Court intervention is essential.”
Apple disputes those accusations, arguing that it had already fulfilled its initial obligation to produce documents explaining how it arrived at the proposed rates.

The company also blames Epic for the delays, saying the Fortnite maker took weeks to submit additional document requests, and subsequently demanded extensive searches involving 27 individuals. Apple says it has agreed to those requests and expects to substantially complete its production by November 25.

In the document, Epic also disputes Apple’s assertions that only four senior executives were involved in determining the proposed commission rates, those four executives being Tim Cook, Eddy Cue, Kevan Parekh, and Carson Oliver.

Epic argues that the decision was also informed by discussions and analyses conducted by other teams within Apple, including work on alternative commission structures in markets outside the United States. (And speaking of that, there is also a dispute over whether Epic should have access to documents concerning Apple’s international commission policies.)

Apple, in turn, maintains that the decision-making process was much narrower than the one behind its original 27% commission, and relied heavily on analyses conducted by outside experts rather than broader internal discussions.

Apple says it has already provided the business records and data that informed its proposal, and disputes Epic’s assertion that a larger group of employees must have been involved in determining the new rates.

Throughout its rebuttal of Epic’s accusations, Apple repeatedly emphasizes that it has agreed to Epic’s requests for additional documents and broader searches, arguing that the scope of those demands, and the time Epic took to make them, are responsible for the delays.

Apple also says Epic caught it by surprise by asking the court to impose a November 1 deadline for completing document production, rather than first discussing that deadline with Apple. The company makes a similar argument about Epic’s objections to the scope of the documents Apple agreed to produce, saying Epic should have raised those concerns directly before seeking court intervention.

Epic, on the other hand, says “Apple feigns surprise at every request Epic raises, as if the Parties, this Court, Magistrate Judge Hixson, and three Court-appointed special masters did not just recently complete a months-long process to extract from Apple documents Epic was clearly entitled to receive.”
For this reason, Epic asks the court to order Apple to:
“[I]mmediately begin rolling document productions and fully complete its productions on a reasonable timeline, and by no later than November 1, 2026”
“[P]roduce by said deadline all relevant documents, without regard to the artificial limitations Apple has placed on the scope of its production, as further detailed [in the document].”

evidence.discovery_lead: 快科技10月12日消息， 小米REDMI显示器推出A27U 2027，价格为 1199 元。 A27U 2027采用三微边设计，大幅提升屏幕可视范围，带来更好的多联屏观影体验，也提高了工作效率。 其配备27英寸IPS面板，可视角度为178度（水平和垂直），色深为10bit，分辨率为3840 x 2160，最高刷新率支持75Hz，响应时间为6ms（典型值）。 同时，其典型亮度为400尼特，对比度为1500:1，RGB色域为100%，DCI-P3色域为99%，色准ΔE＜1，获得了VESA DisplayHDR 400认证。 该款显示器采用“小米青山护眼”方案，同时采用DC调光，通过了德国莱茵TÜV低蓝光认证。 另外还支持全新M Mode模式，一键适配苹果生态色彩，自动适配苹果设备色彩格式，无需反复校色，带来始终如一的色彩显示。 在接口方面，A27U 2027配备了2×HDMI 2.0、2×DP 1.4和1×Audio out接口。

units.text: 快科技10月12日消息，小米REDMI显示器推出A27U 2027，价格为1199元。
A27U 2027采用三微边设计，大幅提升屏幕可视范围，带来更好的多联屏观影体验，也提高了工作效率。
其配备27英寸IPS面板，可视角度为178度（水平和垂直），色深为10bit，分辨率为3840 x 2160，最高刷新率支持75Hz，响应时间为6ms（典型值）。
同时，其典型亮度为400尼特，对比度为1500:1，RGB色域为100%，DCI-P3色域为99%，色准ΔE＜1，获得了VESA DisplayHDR 400认证。
该款显示器采用“小米青山护眼”方案，同时采用DC调光，通过了德国莱茵TÜV低蓝光认证。另外还支持全新M Mode模式，一键适配苹果生态色彩，自动适配苹果设备色彩格式，无需反复校色，带来始终如一的色彩显示。
在接口方面，A27U 2027配备了2×HDMI 2.0、2×DP 1.4和1×Audio out接口。

units.text: Apple has announced that ‘Remnants,’ the first immersive horror film on Vision Pro, is coming this week. Here’s a teaser video.
‘Remnants’ horror film comes to Vision Pro this Friday in Apple Immersive

Apple Immersive is a unique 180-degree video format designed for Vision Pro. And while we’ve seen immersive videos that capture sports and plenty of documentary-style short films, Apple just announced the first horror film is coming soon.
Remnants premieres this Friday, October 16 in the Apple TV app exclusively on Vision Pro.
From writer and director Ti West, Remnants takes viewers inside Woldmere Castle and the “terrifying world” created by West.
Here’s a teaser video Apple just shared that shows real viewer reactions:
If you’re a fan of horror, Apple Immersive on Vision Pro should make for an especially unique viewing experience for enjoying the genre.

evidence.title: Security Bite: This nifty privacy app blurs your Mac screen the second you look away - 9to5Mac

units.text: Who said all privacy protections had to be digital nowadays? In my line of work, traveling can be common, and working from a coffee shop, train, or hotel lounge is something I do on the regular. So when I came across this nifty privacy app that knows to blur your screen the second you look away, I was enthralled.

The app is called ShyGlass, and it comes from developer Max Rovensky, who posted a 10-second demo on X last month that has since racked up over 230,000 views. The way it works is pretty simple. While wearing a pair of AirPods, if you turn your head to a certain degree, your MacBook screen blurs. When you turn your head back, the screen unblurs itself.

Behind the scenes, it’s using the motion sensors Apple uses for dynamic head tracking in Spatial Audio, the feature that keeps your music anchored when you look around. ShyGlass uses the same motion data but to detect presence. A user calibrates a center position from the menu bar, and anytime head positioning drifts past a set angle (15° by default, adjustable from 2° to 30°), a blur fades in over the display until it’s fully covered.

Now this is Security Bite after all, so I have a couple of thoughts on the permission the app needs: Screen Recording. ShyGlass does need to pull a snapshot of a user’s display to apply the blur effect, which kind of sounds a little ironic for a privacy tool. According to the developer, the snapshot stays in memory and is never saved or uploaded, and capture stops the moment the blur does.

I have no reason to doubt that. But it’s worth bring up the trade here. Screen Recording is one of the most powerful permissions on the Mac. An app with it can see everything you see, all the time, and macOS has no way of enforcing that it only looks when it says it does. So you’re basically taking the developer at his word.

Still, I find its functionality useful more often than not. Like turning to chat with the person next to you on a flight, or digging through your bag in a public space. Any time your head leaves the screen, there’s a window where someone else’s eyes can land on whatever you’re working on.
I hope to see Apple implement a macOS feature like this one day.
But if you want to check out ShyGlass, the developer has it priced at $4. It’s available on macOS 14 or later and requires AirPods 3 or later, any AirPods Pro, or AirPods Max.

evidence.raw_lead: Apple saw its share of global smartphone shipments cross 20% for the first time in a third quarter, despite an industry-wide decline.
evidence.title: iPhone hits record Q3 shipment share as global smartphone market plunges 20%, per report - 9to5Mac

units.text: According to Counterpoint Research, Apple saw its share of global smartphone shipments cross 20% for the first time in a third quarter, despite an industry-wide decline. Here are the details.
’The second successive quarter to take the full brunt of the memory crisis’

In a report released today, Counterpoint Research says memory constraints and rising prices have pushed global smartphone shipments to their lowest third-quarter level in 14 years, with a 20% year-over-year decline. The report doesn’t say what that translates to in absolute numbers.

According to Counterpoint Research, Apple shipped 22% of all smartphones during Q3 2026, up from 18% in the year-ago period. That helped it narrow the gap with Samsung, which remained in first place with a 23% share.
The top five also included Xiaomi (10%), OPPO (9%), and vivo (8%), all of which saw their shipment shares decline compared to Q3 2025.
Here’s Counterpoint Research on Apple’s performance for the period:

Apple’s market share crossed 20% for the first time in any Q3, reaching 22%, despite a YoY decline in shipments. The volume decline was largely driven by the absence of a base iPhone 18, which resulted in a smaller launch-month channel fill than the full iPhone 17 lineup a year earlier. Apple also joined the industry wide shift toward price hikes, although the impact was limited to the final weeks of the quarter. However, the iPhone 18 Pro models saw a stronger launch than their predecessors, particularly in China and India, while sustained momentum from the iPhone 17 series helped offset a higher shipment decline.

Looking ahead, the report noted that things don’t look particularly encouraging for the remainder of the year, “with OEMs increasingly prioritizing profitability over shipment volumes amid elevated component costs and weaker affordability.”

Counterpoint added that price-sensitive segments will likely face further pressure from higher device prices and limited component availability, with a meaningful recovery in shipment volumes unlikely until costs come down and supply conditions improve.
To read Counterpoint’s full report, follow this link.

evidence.discovery_lead: 据Yahoo报道， 女演员赵露思近日在直播中与工作人员研究新发售的iPhone 18，将新机与旧机反复对比后表示只看出一处差异，直言“这钱花得没必要”， 相关片段随即引发网友讨论。 赵露思近年凭多部戏剧作品人气上涨，一举一动备受关注。 从曝光的直播片段可见，赵露思拿起iPhone 18与旧机对比拍摄，认为画面清晰度等表现差距不大。 她还多次确认差别究竟来自镜头本身还是拍摄距离， 最后表示两部手机拍出的效果“根本看不到差异”，为这点变化换机并不必要。 赵露思此前一部iPhone 12用了约五年，直到今年才更换为iPhone 17 Pro Max。 她也在直播间强调，不会要求粉丝“为爱消费”，喜欢再买、不喜欢完全没关系，自己消费更看重实用与耐用。 据了解，iPhone 18系列于近期正式开售，升级幅度与定价正是近期数码圈的讨论焦点。 此事曝光后，有网友认同赵露思“按需换机”的态度，认为换第二支新机效益不见得高，也有网友表示新机体验因人而异。

units.text: iCloud+ is best known for adding iCloud storage, but Apple keeps improving and expanding its suite of benefits for subscribers. Here’s everything new for iCloud+ added in the last few weeks.
iCloud+ additions include HomeKit Secure Video upgrades, free Apple TV and Arcade for many, higher AI usage limits, more
If you subscribe to iCloud+ or Apple One, you’re probably getting more benefits than you realize.
View all comments
Beyond extra storage, iCloud+ includes features like Hide My Email, iCloud Private Relay, full Apple Invites access, and more.
Here’s everything new for iCloud+ subscribers added in the last few weeks:

HomeKit Secure Video upgrades: Ahead of new Home products launching this week, Apple has upgraded HomeKit Secure Video in several ways. iOS 27’s powerful new features include 4K support, generated video descriptions, clip searching, and noteworthy clips.

Custom Email Domain: If you run a small business or want to use custom emails for your family or for any other reason, iCloud+ lets you set up personalized addresses for domains you own. You were previously limited to three personalized email addresses, but now you can create up to 10 per domain.

Apple TV and Arcade added in 100+ countries: It doesn’t apply to the US, but iCloud+ subscribers in more than 100 countries now get Apple TV and Arcade thrown in at no additional cost. It’s a huge upgrade for many users that makes the service more of a no-brainer in supported territories.

Higher AI usage limits in iOS 27: Specifics are still unclear, but when Apple unveiled iOS 27, it said select iCloud+ plans would include higher usage limits for AI features. We haven’t yet seen evidence of Apple restricting access to AI features, but affected features include Siri AI, new Photos editing tools, Image Playground, and more.
All of these improvements have been added with no price change for subscribers.
Which iCloud+ features do you currently use? Let us know in the comments.

units.text: A new Apple TV 4K will be unveiled tomorrow as part of Apple’s ‘Welcome home’ event. Here are five upgrades it’s rumored to bring.
Here’s every rumored upgrade the new Apple TV 4K will bring
This Tuesday, October 13 Apple is holding its ‘Welcome home’ event where it will unveil several long-awaited Home products.
One of those is a new Apple TV 4K, the first update to the device since 2022.
Here are five new features reportedly coming:
A19 chip, up from the current A15 Bionic
Siri AI
Microphone built into Apple TV box for Siri
Updated Siri Remote with built-in speaker
N1 wireless chip
The A19 chip should make the Apple TV 4K run smoother than current hardware, and offer a significant upgrade over the A15 in the 2022 model. It will importantly also add support for Siri AI.
As is clear from the list of features above, Siri AI is a central focus of the new Apple TV.
Siri won’t merely get a software improvement. It will also be easier to interact with thanks to the built-in microphone in the Apple TV 4K box.
View all comments

Similar to a HomePod, this will enable interacting with Siri entirely by voice, with no need to hit the button on the Siri Remote. I suspect you’ll even be able to ask Siri to find the remote, and it will play a noise on the new Siri Remote so you can find where you left it.
The N1 wireless chip is expected to enable improved reliability with features like AirDrop, and could tie into other Apple Home-related feature improvements.
Beyond these five upgrades, Apple could always surprise us with new features that haven’t yet been rumored. We’ll keep you posted on all the announcements as they unfold this week.
Are you planning to upgrade your Apple TV 4K to the new model? Let us know in the comments.

units.text: Apple TV today released the official trailer for “Being Heumann,” an Apple Original Films release from “CODA” director Siân Heder. Watch it below.
’Being Heumann’ premieres November 13

With an ensemble cast that Apple TV says “includes the largest assortment of Disabled actors ever,” Siân Heder’s “Being Heumann” is set to premiere on the platform on November 13, following a limited theatrical release on November 6.

The movie also stars Mark Ruffalo (Spotlight), Dylan O’Brien (Twinless), and Rob Delaney (Bad Monkey), among others, blending drama and humor to tell the true story of the 28-day occupation of the San Francisco Federal Building by disability rights protesters in 1977.
Here’s Apple TV on “Being Heumann”:

They wouldn’t take Judy Heumann’s phone calls, so she took their building. In 1977, a young disabled woman (Ruth Madeley) and a scrappy coalition of outsiders decide they’ve had enough. What begins as one impulsive act becomes the longest occupation of a federal building in American history, as hundreds spontaneously seize government offices and refuse to leave until the bureaucrat in their way (Mark Ruffalo) takes action. Bringing rebellion in all its forms to the hallowed halls, a movement’s accidental leaders struggle to find their path forward where none has ever been paved for them. Directed by Academy Award winner Heder (“CODA”) and based on true events, “Being Heumann” is the revolutionary, irreverent and deeply human story of the least likely people trying to pull off the impossible and change the lives of millions.

“Being Heumann” is directed and produced by Siân Heder, whose 2021 film “CODA” earned Apple its first Best Picture Oscar in 2022. The film also won Best Adapted Screenplay and Best Supporting Actor for Troy Kotsur.
You can watch the trailer for “Being Heumann” below:
Watch “Being Heumann” on Apple TV
Apple TV is available for $14.99 per month or as part of the Apple One bundle. It features hit TV shows and movies like Ted Lasso, Severance, The Studio, The Morning Show, Shrinking, and Silo.

units.text: Indie Games Week celebrates the App Store’s incredible catalog of games made by independent developers.

Today, Indie Games Week lights up the App Store with a celebration of the incredible catalog of imaginative games made by independent teams with big dreams. Players worldwide can jump into their next adventure with seven highly acclaimed indie games, available for download or pre-order on iPhone and iPad. All week, the App Store will spotlight these indie gems with daily features and curated collections. “Indie games are constantly pushing the boundaries of creativity to deliver unique gameplay experiences to Apple users, and we wanted to take a moment to celebrate these games and the teams that take creative risks to push gaming forward,” said Carson Oliver, Apple’s head of App Store Worldwide. “Whether from a solo developer or a growing studio, the App Store gives bold ideas a global stage — turning daring visions into worldwide hits. We’re thrilled with the incredible games launching on the App Store this week and amazed by their breathtaking artistry, brilliant design, and deeply moving stories.” There are whole new worlds to discover during Indie Games Week, from building empires, to brawling through cinematic combat, to getting lost in another universe entirely. With the critically acclaimed Sifu, Indie Games Week puts the art of combat front and center. This stylish third-person brawler follows a young kung fu student on a relentless path of revenge. Battles are ferocious and unforgiving, with enemies attacking simultaneously, forcing players to parry strikes, chain combos, and weaponize everything around them. Sifu arrives fully adapted for iPhone and iPad, with custom-tuned touch controls, a reworked camera system, and full controller support.
Sifu, from Sloclap and Kepler Interactive.

For players looking for quick bursts of strategy mixed with dark humor, Vampire Crawlers is an invitation to rough up skeletons, bats, and other nefarious creeps in a gothic card battler. The spin-off of the smash hit Vampire Survivors cleverly trades dodging bullets for tactical deck building. Players conquer chaotic dungeon runs by discovering game-changing card combos, uncovering secret relics, and mastering the luck of the draw.
Vampire Crawlers, from poncle and Nosebleed Interactive.

After celebrating a decade of continuous evolution, Hello Games’ groundbreaking space odyssey No Man’s Sky makes its mobile debut on iPhone and iPad on October 28. The game includes every major content expansion to date, including the most recent Cosmos update, where players can command their own space stations. Set in an infinite, procedurally generated universe rendered entirely at runtime, No Man’s Sky lets players explore, trade, fight, and survive across an interconnected galaxy — all in the palm of their hands.
No Man’s Sky, from Hello Games.

Also this week, players can guide a curious feline through an open-world metropolis in Little Kitty, Big City, assemble card armies to conquer royal adversaries in the strategic kingdom builder 9 Kings, dig deep to fend off foes in the alien mining simulator Dome Keeper, or grapple with agonizing moral choices to save a crumbling empire in Yes, Your Grace 2: Snowfall. All will be featured throughout Indie Games Week and are available now to download on the App Store.
Little Kitty, Big City, from Double Dagger Studio.
9 Kings, from Sad Socket and Playdigious.
Dome Keeper, from Bippinbits and Raw Fury.
Yes, Your Grace 2: Snowfall, from Brave At Night and Noodlecake Studios.

To discover more of the App Store’s indie games catalog, explore this in-depth overview of indie gems curated by App Store editors. On Mac, players can browse a great catalog of standout indie titles too in this indie games guide.

evidence.discovery_lead: IT之家 10 月 13 日消息，科技媒体 AppleInsider 昨日（10 月 12 日）发布博文， 报道称摩根大通驳斥 iPhone 18 Pro 需求疲软并削减订单的报道，将 苹果（AAPL）目标股价从 340 美元上调至 360 美元 （上调 20 美元）。 在 10 月 12 日发布的投资者报告中，摩根大通驳斥有关苹果因 iPhone 18 Pro 需求低迷而削减订单的报道，并建议投资者关注更长期的基本面。 摩根大通此前曾因供应受限担忧，在 2026 年 7 月将苹果目标股价下调至 340 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 2,278 元人民币） 。针对近期订单削减传闻，该行分析师称，相关变化未超出苹果每年例行的生产调整范围。 该行同时下调苹果 12 月季度业绩预期，不过将原因归结为 2026 年 iPhone 发布节奏被拆分为两部分。分析师预计，基础版或入门级 iPhone 的潜在买家将等待 2027 年初发布的新机型，因此形成暂时销售缺口。 摩根大通认为，尽管增幅有限，但是 iPhone 18 Pro 目前的需求高于 iPhone 17 Pro。分析师预计，分批上市策略将推动 Pro 机型销量增长。iPhone Duo 预计于 10 月底上市，其销量有望充分弥补基础机型缺位造成的缺口。 摩根大通预测，苹果 9 月季度盈利仅略高于行业预期，供应限制仍是影响因素。到 12 月季度，该行预计 iPhone Duo 销量约为 850 万部；因缺少非 Pro 机型，iPhone 收入预计同比下降约 2%。 相关阅读： 《 内存推高 iPhone 18 Pro 系列售价，曝苹果削减新机零部件订单 》 科技媒体 AppleInsider 昨日（10 月 12 日）发布博文，报道称摩根大通驳斥 iPhone 18 Pro 需求疲软并削减订单的报道，将苹果（AAPL）目标股价上调 20 美元至 360 美元。 科技媒体 AppleInsider 昨日（10 月 12 日）发布博文，报道称摩根大通驳斥 iPhone 18 Pro 需求疲软并削减订单的报道，将苹果（AAPL）目标股价上调 20 美元至 360 美元。

units.text: Apple has a new M6 MacBook Pro launching later this month with a 14-inch screen and the current industrial design. And with its M6 chip, there are three upgrades we can expect from the new MacBook Pro.
#1: Dual 16-core Neural Engine
If AI is in any way significant to your workflows—and with macOS 27’s AI features, it will be for more users—then the M6 MacBook Pro could be a big upgrade.
That’s because the M6 chip includes a Dual 16-core Neural Engine, up from the standard 16-core version available in M5 and prior. Per Apple:

M6 also introduces a Dual 16-core Neural Engine, providing up to 2x the peak compute over previous generations to make on-device AI workflows run even faster. System frameworks can automatically utilize both engines simultaneously, enabling applications to see faster model execution.
#2: 12-core CPU and GPU with powerful new cores
The base M6 chip offers a 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU. Both are solid upgrades over the M5, which was limited to 10 cores each.

M6’s CPU cores are especially interesting, as Apple is bringing three distinct core types to its base chip for the first time. It has 2 super cores, 4 performance cores, and 6 efficiency cores. Here’s what Apple says about each core:
Super cores: “blaze through single-threaded workloads”
Performance cores: “use less power and join the super cores to run demanding multithreaded workloads”
Efficiency cores: “handle everyday background tasks”
Previously only M5 Pro, M5 Max, and M5 Ultra provided super cores and performance cores in a single chip. But now these Pro-level capabilities are available for standard M6 users.
#3: Major efficiency gains to likely improve battery life
M6 is the first Apple chip built on a new 2nm process. And the company says that brings the benefit of “a major leap in performance and power efficiency.”
Currently the only product with an M6 is the new Mac mini, which doesn’t run on a battery.
But in the MacBook Pro, MacBook Air, and other upcoming M6 products, the new chip’s “major leap” in power efficiency is likely to enable longer battery life.
Apple could always opt to shrink the physical battery to offer comparable performance as before, but here’s hoping it uses M6’s improved efficiency to deliver better battery life instead.
What other new features do you want to see in the M6 MacBook Pro? Let us know in the comments.
*Buy Mac with 15% discount from Apple refurbished

units.text: New iPad Mini Could Cost More Than the iPad Air

Apple's upcoming OLED iPad mini could start at close to $799, which would be $300 above the current model's original $499 launch price. That's according to Bloomberg, citing sources indicating another considerable price hike will accompany the new model.
Apple raised the iPad mini 7's starting price to $599 in June. Bloomberg suggests its successor could add another $200 on top of that.
If so, that would put the new iPad mini $50 above the $749 11-inch iPad Air, which offers an M4 chip, a larger LCD display, and Magic Keyboard support.

The new iPad mini is expected to feature an A20 Pro chip, a redesigned speaker setup, a new landscape FaceTime, and water resistance. Bloomberg's sources indicate that Apple will unveil the new device on or around October 27.
New iPad Mini Release Date, Pricing, and What to Expect
The iPad Air is expected to adopt OLED technology early next year, so the upgrade might be worth waiting for, unless the portability of an iPad mini is more appealing to you.

evidence.title: Apple gets a $360 price target from JPMorgan despite iPhone demand concerns - 9to5Mac

units.text: Just days after Apple’s stock took a hit over reports of iPhone 18 Pro production cuts, JP Morgan has raised its AAPL price target by $20. Here are the details.
iPhone Duo to help offset staggered release window

Last Friday, Nikkei Asia reported that, according to “multiple people familiar with the matter,” Apple had told select suppliers to cut component production for the iPhone 18 Pro and the iPhone 18 Pro Max due to “soft demand.”
The report sent Apple shares down roughly 2.5% in early trading, although the stock has recovered much of that loss and closed at $340.97 today.

That said, JP Morgan released a new investor note today (via AppleInsider), arguing that the reported cuts are consistent with Apple’s usual production patterns and don’t necessarily point to an unexpected drop in demand.

The report also comments on Apple’s staggered iPhone launch schedule, with JP Morgan expecting the iPhone Duo to offset the sales shortfall caused by the absence of the regular iPhone 18, which is expected to hit shelves early next year.

Interestingly, earlier today, a separate report from China’s Securities Times claimed that Apple had increased its iPhone Duo orders by 30%, potentially bringing its production for the remainder of 2026 close to 10 million units.

Looking ahead to the December quarter, JP Morgan expects Apple to sell 8.5 million iPhone Duo units. JP Morgan also projects a roughly 2% decline in iPhone revenue year-over-year, but a 2% increase in Apple’s overall revenue.
The firm also continues to flag supply constraints and broader economic pressures that could affect consumer demand.
All in all, JP Morgan raised its AAPL price target from $340 to $360, while maintaining its Overweight rating on the stock.

units.text: Apple is working on a second-generation iPhone Air, and it could address several key limitations of the current model. Here’s everything we know about the iPhone Air 2, including features, release date, and more.
Will there be an iPhone Air 2?

The iPhone Air has reportedly sold worse than Apple expected. The Information reported in November that Apple had indefinitely delayed the release of a second-generation model due to those lower-than-expected sales.
Apple reportedly “notified engineers and suppliers that they were taking the next iPhone Air off the schedule without providing a new release date.”
Shortly thereafter, however, The Information updated its reporting to say Apple wasn’t canceling the iPhone Air 2 altogether and that one is still very much in the works.
iPhone Air 2 features
A second camera
One of the biggest tradeoffs of the ultra-thin iPhone Air design is that it only has one camera. This is reportedly something Apple is pushing to change for the iPhone Air 2.
According to sources including Bloomberg and The Information, the iPhone Air 2 will have a second camera on the back.
Bloomberg says it will be an ultra-wide camera, not a telephoto camera. This would align it with Apple’s base model iPhones, which also have a main camera and an ultra-wide camera.
A20 Pro chip
The iPhone Air 2 will reportedly be powered by the A20 Pro processor, up from the A19 Pro in the current model.
The A20 Pro chip will be Apple’s first 2-nanometer iPhone processor. This new fabrication process will mean the A20 Pro can offer more power and be more efficient in a similar-sized footprint.
The chip will also use another new innovation called Wafer-Level Multi-Chip Module, which integrates the SoC and DRAM at the wafer level for better performance and lower power consumption.
Better battery life
Apple is also reportedly working to improve the battery life of the iPhone Air 2.

According to a supply chain leak, the iPhone Air 2 will have a 3,500mAh battery. For comparison’s sake, the first-generation iPhone Air has a 3,149mAh battery, so this is an increase of more than 10%.
Beyond increasing the physical size of the battery, the iPhone Air 2 will likely offer longer battery life thanks to the efficiency improvements of the A20 Pro chip.

It’s important to remember, however, that there are many variables at play when it comes to an iPhone’s battery life. We’ll have to wait and see the exact numbers when Apple officially unveils the iPhone Air 2.
Vapor chamber

According to The Information, the iPhone Air 2 will feature a vapor chamber cooling system. Apple first debuted its vapor chamber cooling technology in the iPhone 17 Pro, touting significantly improved heat dissipation and performance.
If Apple brings the vapor chamber to the iPhone Air 2, it means the device will stay cooler during high workloads and sustain high performance for longer periods.
iPhone Air 2: Release date
The iPhone Air 2 was originally expected to be released in September 2026 alongside the iPhone 18 Pro lineup.
Most recently, however, Bloomberg reported that Apple plans to release the iPhone Air 2 in spring 2027 alongside the new base model iPhone 18.
What do you think of Apple’s plans for an iPhone Air 2? Is Apple making the right changes and improvements? Let us know down in the comments.

units.text: IT之家 10 月 12 日消息，据外媒 TweakTown 报道，开发者 Skylar Taylor-Barrick 近日发布了开源项目 gbos-vm，可以在搭载 Apple Silicon 芯片的 Mac 上通过支持 GPU 加速的虚拟机运行 Googlebook OS 系统，IT之家附 GitHub 项目地址（https://github.com/skylartaylor/gbos-vm）。
公开信息显示，Googlebook OS 基于 Android 构建，使用 Vulkan 图形 API，而苹果芯片依赖 Metal。为解决两者之间的兼容问题，gbos-vm 借助 MoltenVK 将 Vulkan 调用转换为 Metal 调用，使虚拟机能够直接利用 Mac 的 GPU，而不必退回到由 CPU 承担渲染任务的软件模拟模式。
在安装方面，用户需要先从谷歌服务器下载官方 Dell XPS Googlebook OS 恢复镜像，再通过脚本修改其中针对特定硬件的 vendor 分区，将其替换为 Google Cuttlefish 项目提供的虚拟设备组件，最后借助 QEMU 启动系统。
硬件方面，该项目要求使用搭载 Apple Silicon 芯片、RAM 内存至少为 16GB 的 Mac，并预留约 60GB 可用存储空间。此外，用户还需要安装 Xcode Command Line Tools、Android SDK 和 NDK。开发者还在探索 x86 架构兼容方案，后续有望让项目支持英特尔处理器 Mac。
需要注意的是，gbos-vm 目前仍存在多项问题，例如虚拟机启动时可能导致蓝牙功能崩溃、显示帧率最高限制为 60fps、后台与 TPM 相关的进程也频发崩溃、音频和剪贴板功能不稳定等。同时由于项目重新构建了 vendor 分区，虚拟机无法使用硬件安全元件，导致加密密钥缺少硬件级保护。因此，开发者建议将 gbos-vm 用作开发和实验环境，而不是日常使用的主力系统。

硬件要求方面， 需要Apple Silicon Mac（不支持Intel Mac），至少16GB内存和约60GB可用空间，并需安装Xcode命令行工具、Homebrew、JDK及Android SDK/NDK。
开发者在M5 MacBook上首次启动耗时约45秒，已有人成功在M1 Pro、M2 Max和M4 Mac mini上运行。
不过，这仍是一个实验性项目。 蓝牙在启动时会崩溃，显示帧率被限制在60fps，一个TPM相关进程反复在后台崩溃，音频和剪贴板支持也未经过充分测试。
此外，由于虚拟机没有硬件安全元件，加密密钥缺乏硬件级保护，开发者建议将其作为开发和实验环境，而非日常主力系统。

evidence.discovery_title: No Man’s Sky is coming to the iPhone and iPad
evidence.raw_lead: A decade later, and the No Man’s Sky updates just keep coming.
evidence.title: No Man’s Sky is coming to the iPhone and iPad

units.text: The No Man’s Sky universe is about to get a little bit smaller — but in a good way. Hello Games announced that its long-running sci-fi exploration game will be coming to iOS, with versions for both the iPhone and iPad available starting on October 28th.

According to Hello’s Sean Murray, the mobile version of the game is essentially the full No Man’s Sky experience. “I guess I should say this is not No Man’s Sky Lite,” he wrote in a blog post. It includes all of the game’s many, many updates that have come out since launch — like the gigantic Voyagers expansion from last year — and the only major features missing will be multiplayer and the planetary settlements. Murray likens the iOS version to when the game initially launched on the original Switch. “On Switch we have listened to players and built from there, including with a much expanded version on Switch 2,” he says. “Based on feedback and player numbers we will support iOS in a similar way.”

The game will be playable on the iPhone 11 and 3rd generation iPad Air and above, and the studio says that the download comes in at a surprisingly scant 5GB. It also has newly-designed touch controls, as well as support for controllers, screen casting, and mouse-and-keyboard on the iPad. Murray also notes that “Perhaps most importantly we’ve put tons of work into battery life and thermodynamics, and we’re super proud that No Man’s Sky can be enjoyed for really long comfortable play sessions.” It’ll be “free to try” at launch, though it’s not clear how much the full version will cost.

It’s now been a decade since No Man’s Sky first launched, and the game has changed dramatically since its debut. iOS will be joining a huge list of supported platforms, including Mac, PC, and essentially every modern console, and there’s also a VR version available. Just as significant, Hello has continued to keep the game vibrant with a constant stream of free expansions, including the recent Cosmos update in September, which fleshed out the vast expanse of space with more things to explore.

units.text: 苹果即将推出的新一代iPad mini可能迎来近年来幅度最大的一次升级，但消费者也需要为此支付更高的价格。据彭博社记者马克·古尔曼（Mark Gurman）透露，苹果正在开发的OLED版iPad mini售价将显著高于现款产品，他个人预计，新机起售价可能接近799美元。如果这一预测最终成为现实，新款iPad mini将比目前售价599美元的现款高出200美元，涨幅约为33%。
古尔曼在最新一期Power On通讯中援引自己的消息来源指出，苹果新款iPad mini的价格将明显上涨。虽然他没有提供苹果最终确定的官方售价，但他认为799美元是一个值得关注的参考数字。
目前，苹果尚未正式公布新款iPad mini的售价及完整规格，因此799美元仍然属于媒体预测，而非已经确认的定价。尽管如此，这一价格预期已经引发关注，因为苹果在今年6月刚刚将现款iPad mini的美国起售价从499美元提高至599美元。如果新机再次大幅涨价，iPad mini的定位可能发生明显变化。
此次价格上涨最直接的原因之一，是苹果计划首次为iPad mini采用OLED显示屏。与现款使用的LCD面板相比，OLED能够提供更深邃的黑色、更高的对比度以及更鲜艳的色彩表现，在观看视频、浏览照片和阅读内容时，有望带来更好的视觉体验。
苹果已经在iPad Pro系列中采用OLED屏幕，但将这一技术引入尺寸更小、价格定位相对较低的iPad mini，仍然需要在显示效果与制造成本之间进行权衡。OLED面板的成本通常高于同等规格的LCD面板，因此新机的显示屏升级很可能成为售价上涨的重要因素。
不过，新款iPad mini预计不会直接采用iPad Pro所使用的最高规格显示技术。此前的供应链消息指出，新机可能采用单层LTPS OLED面板，而不是iPad Pro使用的双层串联OLED方案。后者在亮度、功耗和显示性能方面具有优势，但制造成本也更高。
新款iPad mini是否支持120Hz ProMotion自适应刷新率，目前也存在疑问。韩国爆料者曾声称，苹果已经确定采用60Hz LTPS面板。如果这一消息属实，新机的OLED屏幕虽然能够改善对比度和色彩表现，但屏幕刷新率可能与现款iPad mini基本相同，而不会达到iPad Pro的水平。
换言之，消费者可能需要为OLED技术支付更高的价格，却未必能够获得苹果平板电脑产品线中最先进的显示规格。
除了显示屏，新款iPad mini预计还将搭载苹果A20 Pro芯片。根据此前曝光的信息，这款处理器也将用于iPhone 18 Pro系列等高端设备，并采用台积电先进的2纳米制程。
如果这一配置最终得到确认，新款iPad mini相较于现款搭载A17 Pro芯片的机型，将实现明显的处理器升级。新芯片预计能够提升CPU和GPU性能，同时改善能效，并为本地人工智能任务提供更强的计算能力。
此前的爆料还指出，新机可能配备12GB运行内存，高于现款的8GB。这不仅有助于处理复杂的多任务工作负载，也可能为未来更复杂的系统功能和人工智能应用提供更充足的内存空间。不过，内存容量仍需等待苹果正式发布时确认。
在外观和使用体验方面，新款iPad mini预计也会进行多项调整。
首先，苹果可能将前置FaceTime摄像头移至设备的横向边框。这一设计已经逐步出现在苹果其他iPad产品中，能够让用户在横向放置平板电脑、使用支架或键盘进行视频通话时，获得更自然的视线角度。
其次，新机预计采用重新设计的扬声器系统。虽然目前还没有足够信息能够确定具体的声学结构，但相关设计可能会改变现有扬声器的布局，并改善设备的音频表现。
此外，新款iPad mini还可能首次获得一定程度的防水能力。若这一功能最终实现，将使其在日常携带和使用场景中更加耐用。不过，具体防护等级以及是否能够达到其他苹果设备的防水标准，目前尚未得到确认。
在无线连接方面，此前曝光的信息还提到了苹果自研N1无线网络芯片，预计可支持Wi-Fi 7和蓝牙6。蜂窝网络版本则可能采用C1X或C2调制解调器。上述配置目前仍属于传闻，最终规格需要以苹果官方公布的信息为准。
从产品定位来看，新款iPad mini可能正在从一款强调便携性和相对亲民价格的小尺寸平板电脑，逐步向配置更高、售价更贵的产品转变。
现款iPad mini的起售价在今年6月已经上涨100美元，从499美元提高至599美元。苹果当时解释称，人工智能数据中心建设带来的需求激增，正在推高内存和存储芯片价格，消费电子行业因此面临前所未有的成本压力。
如果新款iPad mini的起售价进一步升至799美元，那么与2021年重新设计后的iPad mini长期维持的499美元起售价相比，价格差距将更加明显。即使考虑到新机可能拥有OLED屏幕、更先进的处理器和更多功能，价格上涨幅度仍然值得消费者认真权衡。
与此同时，苹果产品线内部也存在潜在的竞争问题。
目前，11英寸iPad Air的美国起售价为749美元。如果新款iPad mini真的定价799美元，那么它将比iPad Air的入门价格高出50美元。
这意味着，消费者购买新款iPad mini时，必须更明确地认可小尺寸机身所带来的便携性优势。对于更注重大屏幕、键盘输入和生产力应用的用户而言，价格更低、屏幕更大的iPad Air可能更具吸引力。
反过来说，iPad mini也拥有其他苹果平板电脑难以完全替代的特点。它的机身更小，更适合单手持握、通勤阅读、旅行携带以及在狭小空间内使用。对于希望获得完整iPad应用体验，却不愿随身携带大尺寸平板电脑的用户而言，小尺寸机身本身就具有价值。
因此，新款iPad mini能否接受更高的定价，很大程度上取决于苹果如何平衡硬件升级与产品定位。如果新机确实提供显著的性能提升、更好的显示效果和更强的耐用性，部分用户可能愿意接受涨价；但对于只需要阅读、浏览网页和观看视频的消费者而言，现款产品或其他价格更低的iPad仍可能是更经济的选择。
按照古尔曼此前的报道，苹果计划在10月下旬左右推出新款OLED iPad mini，并可能与采用OLED触摸屏的MacBook Pro新品同期亮相。外界预计，相关产品可能在10月27日前后发布，但苹果仍需正式公布具体安排。
如果这一时间表准确，新款iPad mini距离正式亮相已经不远。不过，在苹果公布售价、屏幕刷新率、内存配置和其他关键规格之前，消费者仍应将目前的消息视为预测，而不是已经确定的产品信息。
总体来看，OLED屏幕、A20 Pro芯片以及摄像头和扬声器系统的调整，有望让新款iPad mini成为近年来升级幅度较大的一代产品。但如果799美元的起售价最终成真，苹果也将面临一个现实问题：当一款以便携性见长的小尺寸平板电脑越来越接近高端产品的价格区间时，消费者是否仍愿意为它支付如此高的溢价。
答案最终将取决于实际产品表现，以及苹果能否证明这些升级足以抵消价格上涨带来的购买门槛。

在无线连接方面，此前曝光的信息还提到了苹果自研N1无线网络芯片，预计可支持Wi-Fi 7和蓝牙6。蜂窝网络版本则可能采用C1X或C2调制解调器。上述配置目前仍属于传闻，最终规格需要以苹果官方公布的信息为准。
现款iPad mini的起售价在今年6月已经上涨100美元，从499美元提高至599美元。苹果当时解释称，人工智能数据中心建设带来的需求激增，正在推高内存和存储芯片价格，消费电子行业因此面临前所未有的成本压力。
如果新款iPad mini的起售价进一步升至799美元，那么与2021年重新设计后的iPad mini长期维持的499美元起售价相比，价格差距将更加明显。即使考虑到新机可能拥有OLED屏幕、更先进的处理器和更多功能，价格上涨幅度仍然值得消费者认真权衡。
目前，11英寸iPad Air的美国起售价为749美元。如果新款iPad mini真的定价799美元，那么它将比iPad Air的入门价格高出50美元。
按照古尔曼此前的报道，苹果计划在10月下旬左右推出新款OLED iPad mini，并可能与采用OLED触摸屏的MacBook Pro新品同期亮相。外界预计，相关产品可能在10月27日前后发布，但苹果仍需正式公布具体安排。
总体来看，OLED屏幕、A20 Pro芯片以及摄像头和扬声器系统的调整，有望让新款iPad mini成为近年来升级幅度较大的一代产品。但如果799美元的起售价最终成真，苹果也将面临一个现实问题：当一款以便携性见长的小尺寸平板电脑越来越接近高端产品的价格区间时，消费者是否仍愿意为它支付如此高的溢价。

evidence.discovery_lead: Tim Cook is visiting China for the third time this year, with talks in Guangdong focused on expanding Apple's manufacturing and sales operations, the South China Morning Post reports. This is Cook's first China trip in his capacity as Apple's executive chairman. He moved into the position on September 1 when John Ternus took over as CEO. Apple has said part of Cook's work involves relationships with government policymakers. On October 11, Cook reportedly held talks with Guangdong governor Meng Fanli. Suppliers and partners located in Guangdong play a major role in Apple's business in China, and Cook is said to have expressed interest in doing more locally through smart manufacturing and additional sales channels. Meng said the province would support further expansion, including research and development. In Guangzhou, a creator used an iPhone 18 Pro to capture martial arts footage while Cook watched. Cook posted "Great to be back in China!" on Weibo on Saturday. Customers also reported a visit to one of Guangzhou's Apple Stores on Sunday. Cook traveled to Chengdu and Beijing in March as Apple celebrated its 50th anniversary, and addressed the China Development Forum. In May, he was among the business leaders who accompanied President Donald Trump for talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping. The trip comes several weeks after sales of the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ and ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ Max started. Counterpoint Research put Apple first in China's smartphone sales ranking for September 14 to 20. During their first three days on sale in China, the new Pro phones sold 12% more units than their predecessors had managed over the full first week of availability last year. This is Cook's first China trip in his capacity as Apple's executive chairman. He moved into the position on September 1 when John Ternus took over as CEO. Apple has said part of Cook's work involves relationships with government policymakers.

On October 11, Cook reportedly held talks with Guangdong governor Meng Fanli. Suppliers and partners located in Guangdong play a major role in Apple's business in China, and Cook is said to have expressed interest in doing more locally through smart manufacturing and additional sales channels. Meng said the province would support further expansion, including research and development.

In Guangzhou, a creator used an iPhone 18 Pro to capture martial arts footage while Cook watched. Cook posted "Great to be back in China!" on Weibo on Saturday. Customers also reported a visit to one of Guangzhou's Apple Stores on Sunday.

Cook traveled to Chengdu and Beijing in March as Apple celebrated its 50th anniversary, and addressed the China Development Forum. In May, he was among the business leaders who accompanied President Donald Trump for talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping.

The trip comes several weeks after sales of the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ and ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ Max started. Counterpoint Research put Apple first in China's smartphone sales ranking for September 14 to 20. During their first three days on sale in China, the new Pro phones sold 12% more units than their predecessors had managed over the full first week of availability last year.

evidence.discovery_lead: Yet another report from yet another source that has no real idea what Apple or its suppliers are doing, conflates parts orders with iPhone production. As before, this means nothing for iPhone demand. Apple's iPhone Duo is reportedly a hit, although it hasn't actually come out yet. As AppleInsider recently pointed out , and investment firm JP Morgan even more recently agreed , Apple has not cut orders for the iPhone 18 Pro . Now a new report says that it must have cut those orders, because it's raised how many of the iPhone Duo it wants built. According to Chinese financial news site STCN , Apple has increased orders for the iPhone Duo by 30%. This is for devices expected to be sold before the end of 2026. evidence.discovery_lead: Apple is marking India's festive diwali season with a limited edition of the AirPods 5 , featuring a rangoli-inspired engraving. The case's design draws on the traditional Indian art form, arranging a decorative pattern around a heart-eyes emoji. The earbuds cost ₹17,900 (approximately $187), matching the Indian price of the regular AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case. The celebrations also include free rangoli workshops created with artist Arushi Kathuria. Participants will use Procreate on the iPad with an Apple Pencil , including a custom brush that recreates the appearance of powder. Sessions run from October 14 through November 9 in India and at selected locations in the United States, Canada, Malaysia, and Singapore. Sales of the limited edition AirPods began on October 11 and will continue through to November 11, 2026, subject to stock. Customers can order through Apple's online store and Apple Store app, or purchase at its six retail locations in India. Apple limits purchases to two pairs per customer and excludes the edition from other AirPods promotions and Business, Education, and Corporate Employee Purchase Plan pricing. Its purchase terms also caution that repairs or replacements may involve standard-edition ‌AirPods 5‌ with Wireless Charging Case, depending on supply. (Thanks, svish!) The case's design draws on the traditional Indian art form, arranging a decorative pattern around a heart-eyes emoji. The earbuds cost ₹17,900 (approximately $187), matching the Indian price of the regular AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case.

The celebrations also include free rangoli workshops created with artist Arushi Kathuria. Participants will use Procreate on the iPad with an Apple Pencil, including a custom brush that recreates the appearance of powder. Sessions run from October 14 through November 9 in India and at selected locations in the United States, Canada, Malaysia, and Singapore.

Sales of the limited edition AirPods began on October 11 and will continue through to November 11, 2026, subject to stock. Customers can order through Apple's online store and Apple Store app, or purchase at its six retail locations in India.

Apple limits purchases to two pairs per customer and excludes the edition from other AirPods promotions and Business, Education, and Corporate Employee Purchase Plan pricing. Its purchase terms also caution that repairs or replacements may involve standard-edition ‌AirPods 5‌ with Wireless Charging Case, depending on supply.
(Thanks, svish!)

units.text: 苹果旗下音频品牌Beats即将展开又一次跨界合作，而这次合作对象则是全球知名娱乐IP《宝可梦》。当地时间10月12日，Beats通过社交平台发布预热视频，提前预告双方即将推出联名产品。
在这段时长较短的宣传片中，Beats打出了“是时候捕捉一些新东西了”的宣传语。画面中出现了一款疑似Beats Pill便携音箱的产品，但整体外观被强光包围，仅能隐约看到部分配色与轮廓细节。
从视频透露的信息来看，音箱前部网罩区域出现了类似电火花的图案元素，这也让外界猜测产品设计可能会融入《宝可梦》中最具代表性的电属性角色皮卡丘。此外，宣传片还加入了卡通风格的闪光、火焰以及电流特效，这些视觉元素与《宝可梦》系列游戏和动画中角色施展技能时的表现风格十分相似。
影片结尾同时展示了Beats与宝可梦的品牌标识，进一步确认双方正在展开官方合作。不过，目前两家公司尚未公布联名产品的正式外观、售价以及上市时间等具体信息。
Beats长期以来热衷于推出跨界合作产品。此前，该品牌曾与多位设计师、明星及知名品牌推出特别版本产品，包括韩国流行音乐歌手Jennie以及运动品牌Nike等合作项目。
作为此次联名最有可能的基础产品，现款Beats Pill于2024年推出更新版本。该产品当时在专业评测中获得了较高评价，凭借出色的音质表现和续航能力受到关注，官方售价为149.99美元。虽然机身重量略高于部分竞品，但整体使用体验依然获得肯定。
随着预热活动正式启动，外界预计Beats将在近期公布这款宝可梦联名音箱的完整信息。如果相关猜测属实，这款产品有望成为Beats Pill系列又一款面向粉丝和收藏用户的特别版产品。

evidence.discovery_lead: IT之家 10 月 13 日消息，科技媒体 9to5Mac 昨日（10 月 12 日）发布博文， 报道称苹果美国官网上线“切换到 Safari”（Switch to Safari）宣传活动，通过新网页与两段视频推广 Safari 在 Mac 上的续航、速度与隐私表现。 整体定位方面，苹果公司在新宣传页面中，通过对比 Chrome 和 Safari 浏览器，从而突显 Safari 浏览器的诸多优势，包括更长电池续航、更强隐私保护与更快性能。 苹果称，与 Chrome 相比，Safari 在 Mac 上可提供最多 5 小时的视频流媒体播放时间。在加载经常访问的网站时，Safari 的速度最高比 Chrome 快 35%。 隐私方面，苹果表示 Chrome 允许更多第三方跟踪器跨网站跟踪用户，并收集数据后出售给广告商。苹果还称 Chrome 不会记住用户希望隐藏的干扰内容。 功能 Safari Chrome 在 Mac 上浏览时，常用网站的页面加载速度更快 是 否 Mac 单次充电即可全天播放流媒体视频 是 否 动画内容的渲染性能更佳 是 否 高级 Web 应用中的 JavaScript 性能更快 是 否 默认阻止第三方 Cookie 跟踪您 是 否 利用机器学习对抗跟踪 是 否 在“无痕浏览”中阻止已知跟踪器 是 否 可隐藏令人分心的内容，并记住您的偏好 ² 是 否 在 Mac 上播放 YouTube、Netflix 和 Apple TV 的 4K HDR 视频⁵ 是 否 新页面提供 Safari 与 Chrome 的并排比较图表，并介绍阅读模式（Reader Mode）、通知我（Notify Me）、配置文件（Profiles）与 Apple Pay 等功能。 苹果同时发布两段视频，分别展示 Safari 的干扰控制（Distraction Control）与智能跟踪预防（Intelligent Tracking Prevention）功能。 干扰控制是 Safari 的页面管理功能，允许用户隐藏网页上的特定干扰元素，例如弹窗、覆盖层或部分广告内容。用户可针对单个网站保存隐藏设置，便于后续访问时保持页面整洁。IT之家附上相关视频如下： 智能跟踪预防是 Safari 的隐私功能，用于限制第三方跟踪器跨网站识别用户。它可阻断或限制跟踪脚本与 Cookie，减少广告商根据浏览行为建立用户画像的范围。 科技媒体 9to5Mac 昨日（10 月 12 日）发布博文，报道称苹果美国官网上线“切换到 Safari”（Switch to Safari）宣传活动，通过新网页与两段视频推广 Safari 在 Mac 上的续航、速度与隐私表现。

units.text: Apple is kicking off a new campaign today to promote Safari’s benefits over Chrome. With a new “Switch to Safari” page on its website and a pair of new YouTube videos, Apple wants everyone to know Safari is “a more powerful and private browser than Chrome.”
On the new website, Apple touts several advantages of Safari over Chrome, including better battery life, stronger privacy protections, and faster performance.
Safari offers up to 5 hours more video streaming on your Mac compared with Chrome.
Chrome doesn’t remember which distractions you want to keep hidden.
Chrome lets more third-party trackers follow you across the web and collect and sell your data to advertisers.
Safari is up to 35% faster than Chrome when loading frequently visited sites on Mac.
The site also includes a side-by-side Safari vs Chrome comparison chart, alongside details on features including Reader Mode, Notify Me, Profiles, Apple Pay, and more.
View all comments
In addition to the new “Switch to Safari” website, Apple has also published two YouTube videos showcasing Safari’s Distraction Control and Intelligent Tracking Prevention.

You can check out the new page on Apple’s website and watch the new videos below. This is only the latest example of Apple’s head-to-head promotion of Safari vs Chrome. Earlier this year, the company launched a new “Privacy on iPhone” campaign promoting Safari as the more private alternative to Chrome.
Do you prefer Safari or Chrome on your Mac? Let us know down in the comments.

units.text: 苹果首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo将于10月16日开启预购，苹果高管也在这一关键节点来到中国，考察新机生产及供应链情况。据媒体报道，日前，苹果首席运营官（COO）萨比赫·汗到访河南郑州富士康科技园，实地考察苹果新品生产情况。
值得注意的是，iPhone Duo由富士康中国工厂独家组装生产，目前工厂正加紧备货，为即将到来的新机发售做准备。
此次考察中，萨比赫·汗参观了iPhone Duo生产线的关键制程，以及iPhone 18 Pro后置摄像头模组产线、外观中框阳极氧化车间和SoC芯片级表面溅镀智能制造车间。
萨比赫·汗在接受采访时表示，郑州富士康园区可以说是全球最大的iPhone制造工厂，甚至是全球最大的智能手机制造工厂。
据了解，2025年底，富士康与郑州航空港区管委会国资平台合资成立河南鸿创科技有限公司。
这是富士康在郑州成立的首家国企合资企业，注册资本20亿元，主要从事高端电子元器件研发与制造。
该公司已于今年7月投产，据报道，项目首期累计产值预计可达1000亿元。
苹果官网显示，iPhone Duo将于10月16日20:00正式开启预购，10月23日发售，国行起售价15999元。

units.text: 快科技10月13日消息，市场研究机构Counterpoint Research发布的最新行业数据显示，2026年第三季度全球智能手机出货量同比下滑20%，整体规模降至自2012年以来同季度最低水平。
这一惨淡数字不仅创下近14年第三季度的最差表现，也直接反映出当下全球智能手机行业正面临近年来最严峻的市场压力。
报告明确指出，上游存储芯片价格持续飙升、全行业供应分配短缺，是本轮手机市场出货量大幅下滑的最核心原因。
随着全球AI基础设施建设热潮持续推进，越来越多DRAM和NAND闪存的产能被优先分配给数据中心和人工智能服务器市场，直接导致智能手机行业能拿到的存储资源大幅缩减，硬件采购成本出现了前所未有的显著上升。
面对元器件采购成本的持续走高，几乎所有主流手机厂商都被迫上调终端产品售价，同时主动缩减备货出货规模，将经营重点从过去追求销量抢市场份额，转向优先维护自身经营利润率。产品售价的普遍上涨进一步削弱了普通消费者的换新需求，这种现象在中低端手机市场表现得尤为明显。
消费者更换手机的平均周期也正在不断拉长，越来越多普通用户选择继续沿用手上的旧设备，同时大众对翻新机市场的接受度也在稳步提升。除此之外，当下消费者选购新机时，更倾向于选择综合价值更高、使用寿命更长的产品，不再像过去那样追求每年甚至每半年就升级一次设备。
从各大厂商的具体表现来看，三星依旧牢牢守住了全球第一的位置，本季度市场份额稳定在23%。
苹果则成为本季度市场表现最受关注的厂商，它的全球市场份额一路升至22%，首次在第三季度突破20%大关。不过即便如此，苹果本季度的整体出货量和去年同期相比依然有所下降。
整个Android阵营中的中国品牌承受了更大的经营压力，几乎所有主流国产品牌的整体出货量同比跌幅都超过20%。
业内分析师普遍预测，定位高端旗舰的手机产品受本轮行业下行的影响相对较小，因为这类产品的目标用户对于价格上涨的敏感度很低，同时旗舰机型本身的利润空间也足够充裕，能抵消上游元器件涨价带来的冲击。
相比之下，那些核心业务完全依赖入门级和中端市场的手机品牌，接下来将面临前所未有的生存挑战，未来很长一段时间里，全球智能手机行业大概率会持续经历销量萎缩，同时伴随新一轮的市场整合洗牌。

units.text: 摩根大通据称认为，近期有关苹果削减iPhone 18 Pro系列订单的消息，尚不足以证明需求明显转弱。该行在一份投资者报告中将苹果目标价从340美元上调20美元至360美元，并建议投资者把目光放到更长周期。目标价属于分析师预测，并非苹果股价保证达到的水平。

争议源于供应链订单报道。日经亚洲10月9日援引多名知情人士称，苹果要求部分供应商下调iPhone 18 Pro和Pro Max的零部件产量，10月相关订单较原计划减少至少15%；报道将其与存储芯片成本上涨、手机售价提高及消费需求偏弱联系起来。路透社转述了这项说法，但表示无法立即独立核实，苹果当时也未立即回应。CNBC随后报道，摩根士丹利也支持至少15%的零部件订单下调说法。需要注意的是，这些消息谈的是组件采购或生产安排，并非苹果已确认下调成品手机销量目标。

摩根大通则称，目前情况更像苹果每年都会进行的常规生产调整，而非需求突然崩落。苹果今年将iPhone发布节奏拆分：iPhone 18 Pro系列已在9月推出，基础款iPhone 18和iPhone 18e据分析师预测要到2027年初才会上市，因此部分等待标准机型的消费者可能推迟购买。摩根大通认为，iPhone 18 Pro目前需求略高于去年同期的iPhone 17 Pro，后者也仍在热销；分批发布反而可能让Pro机型在部分时段占比提高。上述销量判断来自券商分析，并非苹果公开披露的数据。

摩根大通还预计，苹果首款折叠机iPhone Duo在10月底开售后，可能弥补部分短期销量缺口。该行预测苹果在截至12月的季度售出约850万台Duo。由于同期缺少新一代基础款，iPhone销量和iPhone业务收入可能同比下降约2%；但更高的产品售价以及Duo较高的售价，有望推动苹果整体季度营收同比增长约2%。这些数字均为预测。对于截至9月的季度，摩根大通预期苹果业绩仅略高于市场普遍预期，供应限制仍可能影响表现；7月该行曾因供应约束担忧将目标价下调至340美元，此次则转向强调长期前景。
摩根大通同时列出多项风险，包括全球经济环境对消费需求的影响、当地竞争对手可能凭借本土优势调整价格，以及海外政府关税政策对苹果造成的不利影响。苹果CEO交接虽被该行评价为处理得较好，仍被视为潜在不确定因素；此外，收购其他公司也可能分散管理层精力，并带来额外成本或负债。

units.text: 西班牙计算机历史博物馆完成了一台等比例Cray-1复刻展品，标志性的C形机柜内没有复原1970年代的电路，而是装入30台2012至2014年间生产的Mac mini，组成可运行的分布式计算集群。项目历时约18个月，既纪念Cray-1问世50周年，也呼应苹果创立50周年。参观者可通过复古风格的控制台，观看程序从单个处理器核心扩展到整组机器并行执行。
集群由25台双核Core i5机型和5台四核Core i7机型组成，硬件名义上合计70个CPU核心，运行macOS Mojave，并通过消息传递接口协调各节点。它采用分布式并行计算，把任务拆分后交由多台电脑处理；这与原版Cray-1用向量处理器对多组数据执行同一指令的架构不同，因此这是一台借用经典外观、展示现代并行计算概念的展品，而非按原始电路和架构复造的Cray-1。

展品近期使用团队编写的Python矩阵乘法程序测试，当时有64个核心投入运行，成绩约为1.3万亿次浮点运算每秒；此前全部70个核心工作时，项目曾报告约1.5万亿次。项目网站则列出64核、约1.5万亿次的指标，显示公开数字存在口径或测试状态差异。这些都是特定自编程序的测试成绩，并非跨应用的标准化基准，不宜据此简单断言复刻机在综合性能上比原版快多少倍。作为参照，原版Cray-1的理论峰值约为每秒1.6亿次浮点运算，曾用于科学与工程计算，并以向量处理架构闻名。

为让设备适合在博物馆内展示，团队将Mac mini竖直安装在铝制托架上，并利用钢制机架的烟囱效应自然散热，不使用额外机械风扇。报道说，机柜内较明显的噪声来自底部两台千兆以太网交换机，约为30至33分贝，团队计划改用更安静的设备。控制台结合了DEC VT05和Processor Technology Sol-20等老式终端的设计元素，配有三块现代三星显示器和模拟控制面板；最初计划使用CRT显示器，但因新旧接口兼容问题改用平板屏幕。
展览还计划增加软盘驱动器、老式指示灯和仿照HP 250设计的键盘外壳。机柜目前仍有约一半空间空置，项目团队希望通过众筹添置70至80台搭载M4芯片的Mac mini，目标是把集群推向TOP500超级计算机榜单；这仍是未来计划，并不代表现有展品已达到榜单入围水平。

evidence.raw_lead: Apple's redesigned Health app is currently being tested in the iOS 27.2 beta, but it is not expected to be included in the update's public release later this month. As we reported in September, Apple still plans to roll out the redesign in 2026, but it will likely arrive in a future update to iOS 27 after the release of iOS 27.2, which is expected late October.

As we reported in September, Apple still plans to roll out the redesign in 2026, but it will likely arrive in a future update to iOS 27 after the release of iOS 27.2, which is expected late October.

The redesign provides health summaries that update throughout the day, as well as a new Insights tab that looks at your health data over time to calculate your Health Age based on activity level, VO2 max, sleep time, and other metrics. It also uses fitness assessments you can do right on your iPhone to check flexibility, balance, and VO2 max.

In addition, Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 owners will see a readiness score calculated from recent activity, vitals, and sleep score to help them decide whether to take a recovery day or push harder.
Apple also plans to offer a $119 laboratory panel from Quest Diagnostics, which will also contribute to the Health Age score.

Getting the most out of the Health app will require an Apple Watch or another fitness device that integrates with it. Apple says it will initially be available in U.S. English, but it hasn't said when more languages will be added. Expect the update before the holidays.

units.text: 随着苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 正式上市，外界除了关注其折叠形态之外，也对其能够在更薄机身中实现接近桌面级性能的原因产生浓厚兴趣。苹果工程团队近日披露了这款设备背后的设计重点，显示公司在散热、电池布局、芯片调度以及机身结构等多个方面进行了大规模重新设计。
苹果表示，iPhone Duo 并非只是将现有 iPhone 简单折叠，而是一款围绕折叠形态重新打造的产品。由于展开后拥有接近平板电脑的大尺寸显示空间，用户更容易同时运行多个应用、处理复杂任务乃至使用专业级软件，因此设备必须具备远超传统智能手机的持续性能输出能力。
为满足这一目标，苹果在 iPhone Duo 中搭载了全新的 A20 Pro 芯片，并针对其运行环境进行了特别优化。相比传统手机更强调瞬时峰值性能，苹果希望折叠屏设备能够在更长时间内维持高性能运行，从而应对视频编辑、多任务处理、专业创作以及大型游戏等场景。
散热系统成为此次工程设计中的核心环节之一。苹果为 iPhone Duo 配备了专门设计的均热结构，通过更大的散热面积和优化后的内部布局提升热量传导效率。由于折叠机身展开后拥有更大的内部空间，工程师得以采用传统手机难以实现的散热方案，从而减少性能因发热而下降的情况。
电池设计同样进行了调整。苹果采用双电池架构，将电池分别布置在机身两侧，以适应折叠结构需求。这种设计不仅有助于内部空间利用率提升，也让系统能够在保持轻薄设计的同时提供更长续航时间，为持续高负载运行提供基础保障。
与此同时，苹果还重新设计了机身内部结构。为了在超薄机身中容纳高性能芯片、散热组件以及折叠铰链，工程团队对电路板尺寸进行了进一步压缩，并对多个组件进行了重新排列。苹果称，这种高度集成化设计是实现轻薄折叠形态与高性能表现同时存在的重要因素。
在软件层面，iOS 27 也针对折叠形态进行了大量优化。系统能够根据展开或折叠状态动态调整资源分配，并针对多窗口、多任务和跨应用协同进行优化，使设备在处理复杂工作流程时能够更加接近桌面系统的使用体验。
苹果认为，未来移动设备的发展方向不仅是提升性能数字本身，更重要的是持续输出能力以及软硬件协同效率。随着 iPhone Duo 的推出，公司希望证明折叠屏手机不仅能够带来更大的显示空间，还能成为兼具便携性与生产力的计算平台。
从苹果公开的信息来看，iPhone Duo 的研发重点并非单纯追求更薄、更大的折叠机身，而是在散热架构、电池设计、内部空间利用和系统优化等方面进行全面工程重构，使其在移动设备形态下提供更接近桌面级电脑的实际使用体验。

units.text: Apple is celebrating ‘Indie Games Week’ on the App Store by recognizing seven new titles that launched recently or will in the near future. Here are the games being highlighted.
Here are seven new indie games Apple is featuring on the App Store this week
Today Apple announced that it’s kicking off ‘Indie Games Week’ with new and upcoming iPhone games being featured all week on the App Store.
Here are the seven games Apple is highlighting:
Sifu: “critically acclaimed…third-person brawler follows a young kung fu student on a relentless path of revenge”
Vampire Crawlers: “spin-off of the smash hit Vampire Survivors cleverly trades dodging bullets for tactical deck building”
No Man’s Sky: “mobile debut on iPhone and iPad [launches] October 28…includes every major content expansion to date“
Little Kitty, Big City: “guide a curious feline through an open-world metropolis”
9 Kings: “assemble card armies to conquer royal adversaries in the strategic kingdom builder”
Dome Keeper: “dig deep to fend off foes in the alien mining simulator”
Yes, Your Grace 2: Snowfall: “grapple with agonizing moral choices to save a crumbling empire”
The press release includes a quote from Apple’s head of App Store Worldwide, Carson Oliver:

“Indie games are constantly pushing the boundaries of creativity to deliver unique gameplay experiences to Apple users, and we wanted to take a moment to celebrate these games and the teams that take creative risks to push gaming forward. Whether from a solo developer or a growing studio, the App Store gives bold ideas a global stage — turning daring visions into worldwide hits. We’re thrilled with the incredible games launching on the App Store this week and amazed by their breathtaking artistry, brilliant design, and deeply moving stories.”
Are you planning to check out any of Apple’s featured indie games? Let us know in the comments.

evidence.discovery_lead: 这次上手iPhone 18 Pro Max，我选的是勃艮第酒红色。新颜色确实让人多了些新鲜感，但如果你去年刚买了iPhone 17 Pro Max，看到这部手机，大概也不会觉得自己的手机突然就旧了。 今年的升级不少：主摄加入可变光圈，A20 Pro 用上2纳米制程，散热结构继续调整，续航也有进步。单看这些变化，很难说苹果没有认真做产品。可真正到了决定要不要换手机的时候，我还是会想到上一代。 去年iPhone 17 系列把外观、存储、屏幕和散热一起往前推了一步，很多人当时换机的理由，今年仍然成立。所以这部手机最让我纠结的地方，是它足够好，却很难让我替所有iPhone 17 用户找到一个非换不可的理由。 勃艮第酒红色好看，灵动岛变小了 勃艮第酒红色是我对这一代最有好感的地方之一。它比鲜艳的红色更深，配上Pro Max体量很大的机身，整体偏沉稳。如果你觉得黑色太常见，银色又少了一点个性，这个颜色会是很合适的选择。 不过，新颜色终究是新颜色。背部相机区域依然醒目，机身也延续了上一代的设计方向。去年从iPhone 16 Pro换到17 Pro，外观上的差别很容易被看出来；今年从17 Pro换到18 Pro，熟悉感要强得多。戴上不透明的保护壳以后，新配色带来的吸引力还会少一截。 正面缩小的灵动岛，算是这一代比较有技术含量的变化。苹果将Face ID的红外摄像头移至屏幕下方，让灵动岛的宽度进一步缩减。看地图、浏览照片或者横屏看视频时，屏幕遮挡更少，视觉上也清爽了许多。 不过，这项技术也有取舍，屏下传感器区域需要调整像素排列，局部显示精细度有所下降，部分磨砂贴膜还可能影响面容识别。 好在日常使用中，这些影响并不容易察觉。整体而言，小灵动岛确实更好看，但还不足以成为换机的主要理由。 249克的重量在今年的旗舰中算是重的。单手回消息时，既要握稳机身，又要够到键盘和屏幕另一侧；连续输入一大段文字，还是双手更自在。躺着看手机、出门装进口袋，加上保护壳以后，这个重量会来到260克。 整机给我的感觉是：外观没有推倒重来，但颜色把“新”做出了记忆点。对很多人来说，酒红本身就是换机理由的一半。 拍照最值得玩的是可变光圈 今年相机里最值得花时间研究的，是主摄新增的可变光圈。4800万像素主摄可以在?/1.48 到?/4之间调整，系统相机也提供了相应的手动控制。不需要另装一个专业拍摄软件，就能决定光圈、快门和白平衡，这一点挺方便。 我更喜欢用拍咖啡这个场景来理解它。桌上的杯子是主体，背后的菜单和店内陈设要不要清楚，取决于你想留下一张什么样的照片。想把注意力留在杯子上，可以用较大的光圈；想把店里的环境一起记下来，就适当收小光圈。相同的位置、相同的构图，也能有不同的表达。 夜里拍摄也有取舍。收小光圈会减少进光量，手机可能需要提高感光度或延长曝光。面对会动的人物，宁可让背景少一点清晰范围，也应先保证主体没有拖影。看到一个新功能，我会愿意试，但不会为了用它而用它。最重要的是会有星芒的效果。 另外，手机主摄的自然虚化依然受传感器尺寸和拍摄距离影响，不能期待它立刻拍出大底相机的效果。 对经常拍近物、静物、合照的人，可变光圈增加了调整空间；只想拍完就发朋友圈的人，未必每次都能感受到区别。 上一代的相机也没有落后到必须淘汰。iPhone17 Pro 已经配备三颗4800 万像素后摄，长焦和视频功能都很完整。 白天拍风景、出门记录生活，这些需求它依然能很好地承担。18 Pro Max 对拍摄爱好者更有吸引力，普通用户可以先想想，自己究竟有多少次会主动去调光圈。 A20 Pro与新一代均热板：2nm制程搭配更大VC，持续性能更稳 iPhone18 Pro Max搭载A20 Pro ，台积电2nm制程，采用新一代封装工艺。CPU为6核设计，两颗性能核心最高频率冲到约4.93GHz，性能核心较上代最高提升约20%；GPU升级为7核，图形性能最高提升约40%。 神经网络引擎首次双16核、合计32核，端侧AI算力翻倍。内存全系12GBLPDDR5X，存储提供256GB、512GB、1TB到2TB多档。 性能部分，我用Geekbench 7、3DMark和安兔兔分别跑了一遍。在iOS 27.0 下，Geekbench7.1.0 的CPU 单核成绩为4031 分，多核为11432 分。 图形性能方面，3DMarkWild Life Extreme 得到7900 分，平均帧率47.3 FPS。 安兔兔V11.0.2 的总分为3375850 分。iPhone18 Pro Max 排在第三，前面是两款搭载M5 芯片的iPad Pro，也是榜单中排名最高的iPhone。iPhone18 Pro 则以约340.7 万分排在第四，两款A20 Pro 机型的成绩非常接近。 真正拉开差距的是持续性能：连续打了三个多小时高画质游戏，帧率感觉很稳，机身也只是温温热，温度最高为41.3℃。 游戏实测：高负载下帧率更稳，机身温度控制在可长时间握持的区间 没有出现突然降亮度、掉帧糊弄人的情况。新一代VC均热板面积进一步扩大，配合能效更好的2nm芯片，长时间高负载更像在“匀速跑”，而不是冲刺后趴窝。 另外，N1无线芯片带来Wi-Fi7、蓝牙6与Thread，自研C2基带在地库、电梯这类弱网场景里更稳，下载速率和回消息的成功率都比老机型从容。存储方面，256GB起步对大多数人够用；经常拍ProRes或者囤离线剧集，建议直接512GB以上，2TB则更适合把手机当移动素材库的专业用户。 快充是本代最实用的升级之一。实测峰值功率约52–53W，15分钟左右回血一半，30分钟约八成，完全充满一小时出头；无线侧支持Qi2.2 25W。 洗漱吃早饭的时间充进一半，出门前的焦虑基本消失。扬声器饱满、马达干脆、FaceID 稳定，加上灵动岛和实时活动这些“润物细无声”的打磨，上手就能感知到，这是iPhone最不显眼、却最值钱的部分。 好手机，为什么还会被砍单？ 我身边几位去年咬牙上17Pro的朋友，今年摸完18 Pro Max都说“不错，但明年再说”。再加上存储芯片涨价把Pro系列价格推得更高，预算敏感的用户要么继续用17，要么转头去看降价后的17Pro，甚至二手17。 更务实的话，等一等渠道价格，性价比会更好。

units.text: 这次上手iPhone 18 Pro Max，我选的是勃艮第酒红色。新颜色确实让人多了些新鲜感，但如果你去年刚买了iPhone 17 Pro Max，看到这部手机，大概也不会觉得自己的手机突然就旧了。
今年的升级不少：主摄加入可变光圈，A20 Pro 用上2纳米制程，散热结构继续调整，续航也有进步。单看这些变化，很难说苹果没有认真做产品。可真正到了决定要不要换手机的时候，我还是会想到上一代。
去年iPhone 17 系列把外观、存储、屏幕和散热一起往前推了一步，很多人当时换机的理由，今年仍然成立。所以这部手机最让我纠结的地方，是它足够好，却很难让我替所有iPhone 17 用户找到一个非换不可的理由。
勃艮第酒红色好看，灵动岛变小了
勃艮第酒红色是我对这一代最有好感的地方之一。它比鲜艳的红色更深，配上Pro Max体量很大的机身，整体偏沉稳。如果你觉得黑色太常见，银色又少了一点个性，这个颜色会是很合适的选择。
不过，新颜色终究是新颜色。背部相机区域依然醒目，机身也延续了上一代的设计方向。去年从iPhone 16 Pro换到17 Pro，外观上的差别很容易被看出来；今年从17 Pro换到18 Pro，熟悉感要强得多。戴上不透明的保护壳以后，新配色带来的吸引力还会少一截。
正面缩小的灵动岛，算是这一代比较有技术含量的变化。苹果将Face ID的红外摄像头移至屏幕下方，让灵动岛的宽度进一步缩减。看地图、浏览照片或者横屏看视频时，屏幕遮挡更少，视觉上也清爽了许多。
不过，这项技术也有取舍，屏下传感器区域需要调整像素排列，局部显示精细度有所下降，部分磨砂贴膜还可能影响面容识别。
好在日常使用中，这些影响并不容易察觉。整体而言，小灵动岛确实更好看，但还不足以成为换机的主要理由。
249克的重量在今年的旗舰中算是重的。单手回消息时，既要握稳机身，又要够到键盘和屏幕另一侧；连续输入一大段文字，还是双手更自在。躺着看手机、出门装进口袋，加上保护壳以后，这个重量会来到260克。
整机给我的感觉是：外观没有推倒重来，但颜色把“新”做出了记忆点。对很多人来说，酒红本身就是换机理由的一半。
拍照最值得玩的是可变光圈
今年相机里最值得花时间研究的，是主摄新增的可变光圈。4800万像素主摄可以在?/1.48 到?/4之间调整，系统相机也提供了相应的手动控制。不需要另装一个专业拍摄软件，就能决定光圈、快门和白平衡，这一点挺方便。
我更喜欢用拍咖啡这个场景来理解它。桌上的杯子是主体，背后的菜单和店内陈设要不要清楚，取决于你想留下一张什么样的照片。想把注意力留在杯子上，可以用较大的光圈；想把店里的环境一起记下来，就适当收小光圈。相同的位置、相同的构图，也能有不同的表达。
夜里拍摄也有取舍。收小光圈会减少进光量，手机可能需要提高感光度或延长曝光。面对会动的人物，宁可让背景少一点清晰范围，也应先保证主体没有拖影。看到一个新功能，我会愿意试，但不会为了用它而用它。最重要的是会有星芒的效果。
另外，手机主摄的自然虚化依然受传感器尺寸和拍摄距离影响，不能期待它立刻拍出大底相机的效果。
对经常拍近物、静物、合照的人，可变光圈增加了调整空间；只想拍完就发朋友圈的人，未必每次都能感受到区别。
上一代的相机也没有落后到必须淘汰。iPhone17 Pro 已经配备三颗4800 万像素后摄，长焦和视频功能都很完整。
白天拍风景、出门记录生活，这些需求它依然能很好地承担。18 Pro Max 对拍摄爱好者更有吸引力，普通用户可以先想想，自己究竟有多少次会主动去调光圈。
A20 Pro与新一代均热板：2nm制程搭配更大VC，持续性能更稳
iPhone18 Pro Max搭载A20 Pro ，台积电2nm制程，采用新一代封装工艺。CPU为6核设计，两颗性能核心最高频率冲到约4.93GHz，性能核心较上代最高提升约20%；GPU升级为7核，图形性能最高提升约40%。
神经网络引擎首次双16核、合计32核，端侧AI算力翻倍。内存全系12GBLPDDR5X，存储提供256GB、512GB、1TB到2TB多档。
性能部分，我用Geekbench 7、3DMark和安兔兔分别跑了一遍。在iOS 27.0 下，Geekbench7.1.0 的CPU 单核成绩为4031 分，多核为11432 分。
图形性能方面，3DMarkWild Life Extreme 得到7900 分，平均帧率47.3 FPS。
安兔兔V11.0.2 的总分为3375850 分。iPhone18 Pro Max 排在第三，前面是两款搭载M5 芯片的iPad Pro，也是榜单中排名最高的iPhone。iPhone18 Pro 则以约340.7 万分排在第四，两款A20 Pro 机型的成绩非常接近。
真正拉开差距的是持续性能：连续打了三个多小时高画质游戏，帧率感觉很稳，机身也只是温温热，温度最高为41.3℃。
游戏实测：高负载下帧率更稳，机身温度控制在可长时间握持的区间
没有出现突然降亮度、掉帧糊弄人的情况。新一代VC均热板面积进一步扩大，配合能效更好的2nm芯片，长时间高负载更像在“匀速跑”，而不是冲刺后趴窝。
另外，N1无线芯片带来Wi-Fi7、蓝牙6与Thread，自研C2基带在地库、电梯这类弱网场景里更稳，下载速率和回消息的成功率都比老机型从容。存储方面，256GB起步对大多数人够用；经常拍ProRes或者囤离线剧集，建议直接512GB以上，2TB则更适合把手机当移动素材库的专业用户。
快充是本代最实用的升级之一。实测峰值功率约52–53W，15分钟左右回血一半，30分钟约八成，完全充满一小时出头；无线侧支持Qi2.2 25W。
洗漱吃早饭的时间充进一半，出门前的焦虑基本消失。扬声器饱满、马达干脆、FaceID 稳定，加上灵动岛和实时活动这些“润物细无声”的打磨，上手就能感知到，这是iPhone最不显眼、却最值钱的部分。

问题来了：产品本身不差，甚至影像和续航都在补齐长板，为什么市场端反而传出砍单？答案要往回看一年。

evidence.discovery_lead: IT之家 10 月 13 日消息，苹果公司昨日（10 月 12 日）发布公告， 宣布启动 App Store 独立游戏周（App Store Indie Games Week），向全球用户展示由独立开发者制作的游戏作品。 IT之家援引博文介绍，本次首批登陆 App Store 的作品包括 7 款游戏作品： 《师父》（Sifu） 《小猫咪，大城市》（Little Kitty, Big City） 《无人深空》（No Man’s Sky） 《穹顶守护者》（Dome Keeper） 《吸血鬼爬行者》（Vampire Crawlers） 《是的，陛下 2：雪落》（Yes, Your Grace 2: Snowfall） 《九王》（9 Kings） 《师父》由 Sloclap 与 Kepler Interactive 推出，是一款第三人称功夫格斗游戏。苹果表示，该作已针对 iPhone 和 iPad 全面适配，配备定制触控操作、重新设计的镜头系统，并支持完整手柄操作。 《吸血鬼爬行者》是《吸血鬼幸存者》的衍生作品，由 poncle 与 Nosebleed Interactive 开发。该作将动作躲避玩法替换为卡组构筑机制，玩家可通过组合卡牌、寻找遗物和掌握抽牌策略完成地牢冒险。 《无人深空》由 Hello Games 开发，将于 10 月 28 日首次登陆 iPhone 和 iPad。苹果称，移动版包含迄今所有主要内容扩展包，含最新“宇宙”（Cosmos）更新；玩家可在程序生成的宇宙中探索、交易、战斗和生存。 其余作品涵盖不同类型：《小猫咪，大城市》为开放世界猫咪冒险游戏，《九王》为卡牌策略王国建造游戏，《穹顶守护者》为太空采矿模拟游戏，《是的，陛下 2：雪落》则围绕王国治理与道德抉择展开。 苹果公司昨日（10 月 12 日）发布公告，宣布启动 App Store 独立游戏周（App Store Indie Games Week），向全球用户展示由独立开发者制作的游戏作品。

units.text: 10月12日，苹果公司将于10月13日发布一系列智能家居新品。彭博社对此发文称，苹果终于准备公布其新的智能家居战略，填补其生态系统中的最大短板。
苹果公司
之前尝试为何失败？
尽管苹果具备在智能家居领域取得成功的一切要素，包括已销售数十亿部iPhone、智能音箱、电视设备，以及一个对消费者和配件制造商都具吸引力的生态系统，但不知为何，它始终未能攻克这一市场。
苹果首次认真尝试进军智能家居市场是在2014年，当时推出了内置于iOS操作系统的软件框架HomeKit，其初衷是为门锁、家庭自动化设备、安防摄像头及其他联网家电制造商提供一个平台，让它们能够开发相互兼容、并可通过苹果设备控制的产品。
2016年，苹果推出了面向iPhone的“家庭”(Home)应用，为用户提供一个集中管理其兼容配件的地方。但无论是HomeKit还是“家庭”应用，都从未真正流行起来。对于第三方配件制造商来说，开发支持苹果平台并满足其严格要求的产品，成本高昂且过程复杂。
苹果自身推出的硬件产品也寥寥无几，未能带动整个生态系统的发展，其最重要的尝试HomePod智能音箱也始终未能成为主流畅销产品。与此同时，数字助手Siri的可靠性和功能都不足以成为连接整个生态系统的纽带。最终，这导致了一个根本性问题：苹果始终未能给消费者一个足够有说服力的理由，让他们全面拥抱HomeKit。
HomePod mini
亚马逊和Google则采取了不同的策略。它们向市场大量推出自有品牌的安防摄像头、智能门铃、Echo和Nest智能音箱、智能显示屏及其他设备，并配备了功能更强大的语音助手。它们还更加积极地与配件制造商合作，推动各自的生态系统不断壮大，最终涵盖了数以万计的第三方产品。
和苹果封闭生态系统内的可用设备相比，这些产品很多都更便宜、更容易获得，设置起来也更简单。苹果原本可以沿用让iPhone、iPad和Mac取得成功的模式，以自有硬件为核心，辅以出色的软件体验和蓬勃发展的第三方开发者社区，将HomeKit打造成一个繁荣的生态系统。但苹果基本上只提供了底层软件框架，此后便没有太多作为。
而且，苹果也几乎没有大力推广兼容配件，更没有建立起一套强大的营销体系，让HomeKit成为家喻户晓的品牌。换句话说，在近十年的大部分时间里，苹果都将智能家居市场拱手让给了竞争对手。
为何再次尝试？
当时，这一问题并未给苹果造成太大的财务损失，因此公司也缺乏改变策略的动力。如果说，苹果在智能家居领域竞争乏力并未妨碍消费者购买iPhone、Mac和iPad，那么又何必投入时间、资金和资源来解决这个问题呢？
但如今，苹果已越来越难以置身事外。AI的崛起显然已使其整个生态系统面临风险。
如果竞争对手推出一款爆款AI产品，就可能说服消费者把目光投向苹果生态之外。如果有人爱上了亚马逊、Google推出的新设备或OpenAI即将推出的硬件产品，只要其家居尚未与苹果技术深度绑定，那么转投其他生态系统就会容易得多。
这正是苹果第二次进军智能家居市场如此重要的原因。随着新产品定于10月13日星期二发布，苹果不再只是提供底层软件，然后寄希望于其他公司开发硬件，而是推出了一套更全面的战略、一个现成的生态系统，以及一整套专为协同工作而设计的设备。
其中的核心产品是一款名为HomeView的全新智能家居中枢设备。它配备显示屏和A18芯片，实质上相当于Apple Intelligence家居的Siri控制中心。此外，还有两款配套设备：升级版HomePod mini，搭载S10芯片，可将语音控制、音乐播放及其他功能延伸至家中各个角落(不过据称HomeView的音质更好)；以及一款搭载标准A19芯片的新Apple TV机顶盒，将这一体验带入客厅。
HomeView有两个版本：一款是台面式，底部配有金属扬声器底座；另一款是壁挂式，显示屏下方配有扁平的方形底座，可贴墙安装。台面式版本提供深空灰色、银色、星光色和粉色四种配色，壁挂式版本则只有深空灰色和银色两种配色。
苹果目前的Apple TV及其机顶盒
苹果还为新款Apple TV测试了两项功能，这是该产品多年来的首次更新：内置麦克风，让用户可以直接对着机顶盒喊出Siri指令，而无需对着遥控器或配对的HomePod说话；一款经过重新设计、内置扬声器的遥控器，方便用户在沙发坐垫之间寻找遥控器。除了搭载驱动Siri AI的新芯片外，HomePod mini的主要升级还包括推出一系列新配色：粉色、白色、绿色、蓝色和午夜色。
至于HomeView这个名称，其中的“View”(观看)体现了这款设备的设计用途：它是一块供人观看的显示屏，主要通过语音进行操控。虽然屏幕支持触控，但如果取名为HomePad，就会让人联想到类似iPad、以直接触屏交互为核心的使用体验。据MacRumors上周五报道，HomeView这一名称最早出现在一家空壳公司提交的商标申请中。
新款HomePod mini和Apple TV计划于10月30日开始向用户交付，并在零售店上架。至于HomeView，目前预计将在11月中旬左右推出，这意味着它将在发布约一个月后上市。
联手第三方
与iPhone不同，HomeView并非为各种各样的应用而设计。该设备将支持有限的一组苹果应用，且没有可供下载其他软件的App Store。相反，该公司押注于一系列第三方配件，这些配件可连接到HomeView，并可通过Siri、“家庭”应用和其他苹果设备进行控制。
至关重要的是，苹果并没有把整个生态系统的建设完全交给市场。该公司与LG电子展开了一项不同寻常的合作，参与设计和研发了一系列智能家居产品，包括智能门铃、门锁、恒温器、温度传感器，以及室内和室外安防摄像头、泛光灯摄像头。苹果还在与施耐德电气合作，为欧洲市场开发能源相关设备。
这些产品合在一起，构成了一套智能家居入门套件，几乎涵盖了大多数消费者打造联网住宅所需的一切。苹果将其称为“Apple Home Collection”。苹果没有等待第三方制造商花数年时间填补空白，而是从一开始就帮助打造了一整套系统。不过，LG的产品最早也要到今年晚些时候才会发货。
与LG的合作还解决了苹果最初HomeKit战略的另一大弱点：成本。苹果可以影响这些所谓“第二方配件”的功能、性能和整体使用体验，确保它们能够与苹果自己的硬件和软件良好配合。但制造和产品支持将由LG负责，LG也将承担大部分财务负担。
这意味着，与那些由苹果完全自主设计、通过自有供应链生产，并追求其硬件业务通常享有的40%至50%毛利率相比，这些配件能够以低得多的价格卖给消费者。通过让LG承担大部分繁重工作，苹果可以在不牺牲体验控制权的情况下，提供更实惠的产品线。
另外两项进展使这一战略如今变得可行：Siri AI功能的升级，以及智能家居通信协议的进步。两者都有助于弥补苹果最初尝试中的不足。
Siri终于行了
苹果花了数年时间，才让Siri为这一切做好准备。自2024年末以来，苹果一直在尝试推出这批新的智能家居设备(最初的HomeView商标申请也确实是在当年9月提交的)，但由于升级版语音助手一再推迟，整个产品发布计划也屡次受阻。如果推出了颇具吸引力的新硬件，却仍由那个不可靠的Siri提供支持，无疑会是一场灾难。
尽管Siri AI的能力远不及ChatGPT，但它终于兑现了苹果在2011年推出最初版本时所作出的许多承诺：成为一款能够理解用户意图，并真正执行用户指令的助手。与此同时，Matter和Thread标准也帮助解决了长期困扰HomeKit的兼容性和连接问题。苹果的新产品能够与更广泛的现有配件兼容，而不再迫使消费者从头开始搭建智能家居系统。
对苹果而言，智能家居业务取得成功，并不一定意味着超越亚马逊或Google，也不意味着让门铃和恒温器成为新的主要收入来源。至少在未来几年内，这些目标都难以实现。苹果真正想做的，是让智能家居成为其产品体系中不可或缺的一部分，为现有iPhone用户购买更多苹果产品提供理由，同时提高他们转投其他品牌的门槛。
如果苹果能够说服数百万家庭采用新款HomeView、音箱和各类配件，它就能填补其产品阵容中仍然存在的最大短板之一。更重要的是，它将确保下一代AI驱动的设备不会给客户一个理由，让他们抛弃苹果，转投已经控制其家居的竞争对手。

10月12日，苹果公司将于10月13日发布一系列智能家居新品。彭博社对此发文称，苹果终于准备公布其新的智能家居战略，填补其生态系统中的最大短板。
尽管苹果具备在智能家居领域取得成功的一切要素，包括已销售数十亿部iPhone、智能音箱、电视设备，以及一个对消费者和配件制造商都具吸引力的生态系统，但不知为何，它始终未能攻克这一市场。
苹果首次认真尝试进军智能家居市场是在2014年，当时推出了内置于iOS操作系统的软件框架HomeKit，其初衷是为门锁、家庭自动化设备、安防摄像头及其他联网家电制造商提供一个平台，让它们能够开发相互兼容、并可通过苹果设备控制的产品。
2016年，苹果推出了面向iPhone的“家庭”(Home)应用，为用户提供一个集中管理其兼容配件的地方。但无论是HomeKit还是“家庭”应用，都从未真正流行起来。对于第三方配件制造商来说，开发支持苹果平台并满足其严格要求的产品，成本高昂且过程复杂。
苹果自身推出的硬件产品也寥寥无几，未能带动整个生态系统的发展，其最重要的尝试HomePod智能音箱也始终未能成为主流畅销产品。与此同时，数字助手Siri的可靠性和功能都不足以成为连接整个生态系统的纽带。最终，这导致了一个根本性问题：苹果始终未能给消费者一个足够有说服力的理由，让他们全面拥抱HomeKit。
亚马逊和Google则采取了不同的策略。它们向市场大量推出自有品牌的安防摄像头、智能门铃、Echo和Nest智能音箱、智能显示屏及其他设备，并配备了功能更强大的语音助手。它们还更加积极地与配件制造商合作，推动各自的生态系统不断壮大，最终涵盖了数以万计的第三方产品。
如果竞争对手推出一款爆款AI产品，就可能说服消费者把目光投向苹果生态之外。如果有人爱上了亚马逊、Google推出的新设备或OpenAI即将推出的硬件产品，只要其家居尚未与苹果技术深度绑定，那么转投其他生态系统就会容易得多。
这正是苹果第二次进军智能家居市场如此重要的原因。随着新产品定于10月13日星期二发布，苹果不再只是提供底层软件，然后寄希望于其他公司开发硬件，而是推出了一套更全面的战略、一个现成的生态系统，以及一整套专为协同工作而设计的设备。
其中的核心产品是一款名为HomeView的全新智能家居中枢设备。它配备显示屏和A18芯片，实质上相当于Apple Intelligence家居的Siri控制中心。此外，还有两款配套设备：升级版HomePod mini，搭载S10芯片，可将语音控制、音乐播放及其他功能延伸至家中各个角落(不过据称HomeView的音质更好)；以及一款搭载标准A19芯片的新Apple TV机顶盒，将这一体验带入客厅。
苹果还为新款Apple TV测试了两项功能，这是该产品多年来的首次更新：内置麦克风，让用户可以直接对着机顶盒喊出Siri指令，而无需对着遥控器或配对的HomePod说话；一款经过重新设计、内置扬声器的遥控器，方便用户在沙发坐垫之间寻找遥控器。除了搭载驱动Siri AI的新芯片外，HomePod mini的主要升级还包括推出一系列新配色：粉色、白色、绿色、蓝色和午夜色。
至于HomeView这个名称，其中的“View”(观看)体现了这款设备的设计用途：它是一块供人观看的显示屏，主要通过语音进行操控。虽然屏幕支持触控，但如果取名为HomePad，就会让人联想到类似iPad、以直接触屏交互为核心的使用体验。据MacRumors上周五报道，HomeView这一名称最早出现在一家空壳公司提交的商标申请中。
新款HomePod mini和Apple TV计划于10月30日开始向用户交付，并在零售店上架。至于HomeView，目前预计将在11月中旬左右推出，这意味着它将在发布约一个月后上市。
与iPhone不同，HomeView并非为各种各样的应用而设计。该设备将支持有限的一组苹果应用，且没有可供下载其他软件的App Store。相反，该公司押注于一系列第三方配件，这些配件可连接到HomeView，并可通过Siri、“家庭”应用和其他苹果设备进行控制。
至关重要的是，苹果并没有把整个生态系统的建设完全交给市场。该公司与LG电子展开了一项不同寻常的合作，参与设计和研发了一系列智能家居产品，包括智能门铃、门锁、恒温器、温度传感器，以及室内和室外安防摄像头、泛光灯摄像头。苹果还在与施耐德电气合作，为欧洲市场开发能源相关设备。
与LG的合作还解决了苹果最初HomeKit战略的另一大弱点：成本。苹果可以影响这些所谓“第二方配件”的功能、性能和整体使用体验，确保它们能够与苹果自己的硬件和软件良好配合。但制造和产品支持将由LG负责，LG也将承担大部分财务负担。
这意味着，与那些由苹果完全自主设计、通过自有供应链生产，并追求其硬件业务通常享有的40%至50%毛利率相比，这些配件能够以低得多的价格卖给消费者。通过让LG承担大部分繁重工作，苹果可以在不牺牲体验控制权的情况下，提供更实惠的产品线。
苹果花了数年时间，才让Siri为这一切做好准备。自2024年末以来，苹果一直在尝试推出这批新的智能家居设备(最初的HomeView商标申请也确实是在当年9月提交的)，但由于升级版语音助手一再推迟，整个产品发布计划也屡次受阻。如果推出了颇具吸引力的新硬件，却仍由那个不可靠的Siri提供支持，无疑会是一场灾难。
尽管Siri AI的能力远不及ChatGPT，但它终于兑现了苹果在2011年推出最初版本时所作出的许多承诺：成为一款能够理解用户意图，并真正执行用户指令的助手。与此同时，Matter和Thread标准也帮助解决了长期困扰HomeKit的兼容性和连接问题。苹果的新产品能够与更广泛的现有配件兼容，而不再迫使消费者从头开始搭建智能家居系统。

units.text: It looks like Apple’s Beats and Pokémon are teaming up for a Beats Pill Bluetooth speaker collaboration.

Beats shared a short teaser clip that confirms the Apple-owned brand is working with Pokémon as the next collaboration. In the teaser, a Beats Pill Bluetooth speaker can be seen as various elements light up the design.
Time to catch something new. pic.twitter.com/Rt0IfTKENC
— Beats by Dre (@beatsbydre) October 12, 2026

Earlier this month, social media posts showing a Pikachu version of the Beats Pill surfaced at retailer Target. Apple’s Beats Pill Bluetooth speaker goes for $149.99, although you can regularly catch it for $129.
Pikachu, of course, recently visited Apple Park. We’ll share more details when this graduates from teaser to something even more official.

units.text: A new report by Securities Times in China indicates Apple is now anticipating much higher demand for iPhone Duo than initially expected, despite pre-orders not starting until later this week.
Initial iPhone Duo supply for 2026 reportedly nearing 10 million units
Apple launches iPhone Duo pre-orders this Friday, October 16. And you’ll be able to start your pre-order process for the fastest checkout later today.
But despite pre-orders not being live yet, Apple seems to be anticipating significantly higher demand for iPhone Duo than its initial estimates.
According to a report from China’s Securities Times, Apple has increased its orders for iPhone Duo in the supply chain by a massive 30%.

The report says total supply for the remainder of 2026 still doesn’t exceed 10 million units. But based on prior estimates of 6-7 million units being produced, it’s likely that the new target number is close to 10 million.
Clearly, Apple is seeing a better than expected response to the iPhone Duo since its unveiling last month. And its planned retail push adds more evidence to support that.

Supply chain sources also tell Securities Times that iPhone 18 Pro Max orders have increased by 10-15% and iPhone 18 Pro orders have been reduced by 10-15%. The total supply targets for the iPhone 18 Pro line overall are ultimately unchanged, however, contradicting a recent Nikkei Asia report.
Are you planning to pre-order iPhone Duo this week? Let us know in the comments.

evidence.discovery_lead: IT之家 10 月 13 日消息，Epic Games 指控苹果就其提出的 App Store 新佣金费率相关诉讼，人为制造程序暂停的局面，苹果对此予以否认。 IT之家注意到，在一份联合进度报告中，Epic Games 与苹果对苹果提交内部文件、说明其拟定 App Store 佣金费率依据的相关情况，给出了截然不同的说法。 回顾一下，今年 8 月，苹果针对通过 App Store 外部链接完成的交易，提出了一套全新佣金方案。 按照该方案，开发者需要支付的佣金比例为 5% 至 15%。此前法院裁定苹果必须允许开发者引导用户跳转至其他支付方式，苹果在 2024 年推出 27% 的佣金费率，本次新方案相比该费率有所下调。 之后法院认定苹果违反法院指令，苹果正寻求向最高法院推翻这一认定，主张该指令从未禁止苹果收取任何佣金。 在最高法院审理苹果针对藐视法庭裁定提出的上诉期间，下级法院另行审理另一项争议：苹果是否有权对通过外部链接产生的交易收取佣金；如果有权，可收取的费率上限是多少。 苹果近期曾申请暂停该诉讼程序，等待最高法院作出裁决，但这项申请先后遭到下级法院与最高法院驳回。 作为诉讼流程的一环，苹果在 8 月提交了这套 5% 至 15% 的佣金方案以及支撑该费率的相关证据。 Epic 称苹果在近两个月内几乎未提交内部文件，要求法院强制其在 11 月 1 日前完成提交。苹果反驳称是 Epic 调取范围过大导致延误，预计 11 月 25 日前基本完成文件提交。#Epic苹果佣金之争#

units.text: IT之家 10 月 13 日消息，Epic Games 指控苹果就其提出的 App Store 新佣金费率相关诉讼，人为制造程序暂停的局面，苹果对此予以否认。
IT之家注意到，在一份联合进度报告中，Epic Games 与苹果对苹果提交内部文件、说明其拟定 App Store 佣金费率依据的相关情况，给出了截然不同的说法。
回顾一下，今年 8 月，苹果针对通过 App Store 外部链接完成的交易，提出了一套全新佣金方案。
按照该方案，开发者需要支付的佣金比例为 5% 至 15%。此前法院裁定苹果必须允许开发者引导用户跳转至其他支付方式，苹果在 2024 年推出 27% 的佣金费率，本次新方案相比该费率有所下调。
之后法院认定苹果违反法院指令，苹果正寻求向最高法院推翻这一认定，主张该指令从未禁止苹果收取任何佣金。
在最高法院审理苹果针对藐视法庭裁定提出的上诉期间，下级法院另行审理另一项争议：苹果是否有权对通过外部链接产生的交易收取佣金；如果有权，可收取的费率上限是多少。
苹果近期曾申请暂停该诉讼程序，等待最高法院作出裁决，但这项申请先后遭到下级法院与最高法院驳回。
作为诉讼流程的一环，苹果在 8 月提交了这套 5% 至 15% 的佣金方案以及支撑该费率的相关证据。
根据诉讼相关协议，苹果还必须提交内部文件，说明这套费率的制定过程。Epic 可以查阅这些文件，了解苹果拟定收费标准的依据，之后再向法院提交正式答辩意见。
最新的争议就源于此：Epic 指责苹果刻意拖延诉讼进程，苹果则否认相关指控。
在这份联合进度书面材料里，Epic 表示：“距离文件提交截止日期已近两个月，苹果几乎没有提交任何文件。”还提到“苹果始终无法确定文件提交完成的确切日期，这说明必须由法院介入处理。”
苹果不认同上述指控，称自己已经履行了提交文件说明费率制定依据的初始义务。
苹果还将延误归咎于 Epic，称这家《堡垒之夜》开发商耗时数周才提交追加文件调取申请，之后又要求对 27 名人员开展大范围资料检索。苹果表示已经同意这些申请，预计在 11 月 25 日前基本完成文件提交工作。
Epic 在材料中还反驳了苹果的说法。苹果称仅有四名高管参与拟定新佣金费率，四人分别是蒂姆 · 库克（Tim Cook）、埃迪 · 库埃（Eddy Cue）、基万 · 帕雷克（Kevan Parekh）、卡森 · 奥利弗（Carson Oliver）。
Epic 认为，苹果内部其他团队的研讨与分析也影响了这项决策，其中包括苹果在美国以外市场研究其他佣金方案的相关工作。顺带一提，双方还在争议 Epic 是否有权查阅苹果海外佣金政策相关文件。
苹果则坚持，本次新费率的决策流程，相比当初制定 27% 原始佣金的流程范围更小，很大程度上参考外部专家的分析结论，而非大范围的内部研讨。
苹果称，已经提供了支撑方案的业务记录与数据，不认可 Epic 提出的“一定有更多员工参与新费率制定”这一观点。
苹果在逐条反驳 Epic 指控的过程中反复强调，自己已经同意 Epic 提出的追加文件、扩大检索范围的申请，造成延误的根源是 Epic 提出的调取范围过大，以及 Epic 迟迟才提交申请。

而 Epic 方面表示：“Epic 每提出一项申请，苹果都故作惊讶。可就在不久前，双方、本法院、希克森治安法官（Magistrate Judge Hixson）以及三名法院指定的特别主事官，刚刚完成了长达数月的取证流程，从苹果处调取 Epic 本就有权获取的文件。”
基于以上理由，Epic 请求法院判令苹果：
1. 立即分批提交文件，并在合理期限内完成全部提交工作，最晚不得迟于 2026 年 11 月 1 日；
2. 在上述截止日期前提交全部相关文件，不受苹果人为划定的文件提交范围限制，具体要求详见文书内容。

evidence.discovery_lead: IT之家 10 月 13 日消息，《连线》昨日（10 月 12 日）发布博文，报道称在 iOS 27 系统官方输入法中，苹果公司进一步扩展支持原住民语言， 新增支持黑脚语（Blackfoot）、科曼奇语（Comanche）和东北克里语（Northern East Cree）。 博文指出目前 iPhone 18 Pro 等机型支持超过 200 种语言输入， 苹果通过与原住民社区长期协作，为切罗基语等濒危语言提供键盘、字符与输入体验支持。 苹果公司深化和切罗基族（Cherokee Nation）的合作，切罗基语于 2010 年进入 iOS，成为首个获支持的美国原住民语言。切罗基族目前约有 1,500 名活跃使用者，其中多数超过 70 岁，社区正通过沉浸式课程培养第二语言学习者。 IT之家查询公开资料，切罗基族是美国规模最大的联邦承认原住民族之一，也是切罗基人的主权政府，总部位于俄克拉何马州 Tahlequah。该族在文化、语言复兴和数字技术合作方面具有较高可见度，切罗基语也是首个进入 iOS 键盘的美国原住民语言。 苹果称，为原住民语言适配键盘并非单纯翻译，该工作需要多年研究与社区成员参与，并涉及字符编码、字体支持、正字法和键盘布局等多个环节，其目标是将语言使用场景延伸至年轻人常用的手机屏幕。 适配流程始于 Unicode 标准。一个字符必须先被纳入该标准，才能在手机屏幕上输入或显示。Unicode 现已收录超过 157,000 个字符，而提出、验证并编码一种语言的字符集，通常需要 3 至 5 年。 字符编码完成后，苹果和谷歌等平台需提供字体支持，否则字符会显示为空方框，即“豆腐”。随后，双方还需确定正字法。部分语言缺乏标准化书写规则，用户过去会以问号等符号替代喉塞音等特殊语音。 键盘布局方面，苹果也针对不同语言深入定制，例如内兹珀斯语不使用大写字母，苹果将 Shift 键改为显示带重音符号的辅助字符层。切罗基语采用音节文字，苹果在键盘底部加入自适应元音键，输入辅音后自动显示可组合的元音。 《连线》昨日（10 月 12 日）发布博文，报道称在 iOS 27 系统官方输入法中，苹果公司进一步扩展支持原住民语言，新增支持黑脚语（Blackfoot）、科曼奇语（Comanche）和东北克里语（Northern East Cree）。

units.text: IT之家 10 月 13 日消息，《连线》昨日（10 月 12 日）发布博文，报道称在 iOS 27 系统官方输入法中，苹果公司进一步扩展支持原住民语言，新增支持黑脚语（Blackfoot）、科曼奇语（Comanche）和东北克里语（Northern East Cree）。
博文指出目前 iPhone 18 Pro 等机型支持超过 200 种语言输入，苹果通过与原住民社区长期协作，为切罗基语等濒危语言提供键盘、字符与输入体验支持。
苹果公司深化和切罗基族（Cherokee Nation）的合作，切罗基语于 2010 年进入 iOS，成为首个获支持的美国原住民语言。切罗基族目前约有 1,500 名活跃使用者，其中多数超过 70 岁，社区正通过沉浸式课程培养第二语言学习者。
IT之家查询公开资料，切罗基族是美国规模最大的联邦承认原住民族之一，也是切罗基人的主权政府，总部位于俄克拉何马州 Tahlequah。该族在文化、语言复兴和数字技术合作方面具有较高可见度，切罗基语也是首个进入 iOS 键盘的美国原住民语言。
苹果称，为原住民语言适配键盘并非单纯翻译，该工作需要多年研究与社区成员参与，并涉及字符编码、字体支持、正字法和键盘布局等多个环节，其目标是将语言使用场景延伸至年轻人常用的手机屏幕。
适配流程始于 Unicode 标准。一个字符必须先被纳入该标准，才能在手机屏幕上输入或显示。Unicode 现已收录超过 157,000 个字符，而提出、验证并编码一种语言的字符集，通常需要 3 至 5 年。
字符编码完成后，苹果和谷歌等平台需提供字体支持，否则字符会显示为空方框，即“豆腐”。随后，双方还需确定正字法。部分语言缺乏标准化书写规则，用户过去会以问号等符号替代喉塞音等特殊语音。
键盘布局方面，苹果也针对不同语言深入定制，例如内兹珀斯语不使用大写字母，苹果将 Shift 键改为显示带重音符号的辅助字符层。切罗基语采用音节文字，苹果在键盘底部加入自适应元音键，输入辅音后自动显示可组合的元音。

units.text: iPhone Duo pre-orders officially kick off on Friday, but Apple is letting you prepare now. Starting today, you can head to the Apple Store Online or Apple Store app and save your exact iPhone Duo configuration.

You can also prepare your iPhone Duo pre-order payment method. You can pay in full, finance with Apple Card, join the Apple Upgrade program, or check for applicable carrier offers.
View all comments
If you complete this process ahead of time, you can check out in just a couple of taps when iPhone Duo pre-orders officially begin on Friday morning.

units.text: Apple officially confirmed that it will hold a product launch event tomorrow, October 13. With a “Welcome home” tagline, the launch is expected to focus on new smart home products. Here’s everything to expect at tomorrow’s Apple event.
Apple ‘Welcome home’ details

There are two components to the event, as Ryan outlined. There is the in-person experience for members of the press in New York City, as well as what Mark Gurman has called an “online video presentation.”

This suggests we can expect press releases and a video (or videos) to drop around 9 a.m. ET/6 a.m. PT on October 13. Apple hasn’t confirmed this, so the actual launch might vary. At a minimum, though, we know it will announce something on October 13, and some people will see it in person while the rest of us follow along from home.
What to expect
‘HomeView’ smart display

Tomorrow’s headlining announcement will be Apple’s long-rumored smart display product, which Bloomberg says will be called HomeView. Apple believes that this product can serve as a central hub for your house, powered by Siri AI and Apple Intelligence.

According to Bloomberg, the device will have a 6-inch square display atop a half-dome base, with a metal arm holding it up. The HomeView will reportedly come in two variations: one that can be mounted on a wall and one that can sit on a countertop. Reports have likened the design to Apple’s iconic iMac G4.

One of the flagship features of the HomeView will be its ability to recognize multiple people in a household. Mark Gurman reports that it can recognize who is talking to it or approaching it and dynamically adjust what’s shown on the screen.

In terms of software, the HomeView reportedly mixes different elements of the Apple Watch, Apple TV, and iPad. This includes iPad-like app designs and Apple Watch-style icons. It will also heavily borrow from the iPhone for widgets and StandBy mode.
Finally, while HomeView will be announced tomorrow, the latest reporting is that it won’t be available until sometime in November.
New Apple TV 4K

Apple is also expected to announce a new Apple TV 4K, its first update to the set-top box since November 2022. The new Apple TV will look the same as its predecessor, but it will reportedly include the A19 or A19 Pro chip.
That upgraded chip will allow Apple to bring Siri AI and Apple Intelligence features to the Apple TV for the first time.
The new Apple TV could also have built-in microphones for Siri interactions. The Siri Remote, meanwhile, might add a speaker to make it easier to find if you misplace it.

Apple is also reportedly working on new software features for the Apple TV and HomePod. For example, there are code references to a new feature that would let you arrange four full-sized HomePods in a surround sound system when paired with Apple TV.
HomePod mini 2

The HomePod mini will also get its first proper upgrade tomorrow. The big change here will be a new S10 chip that is much faster than the current model’s S5 processor, bringing support for Siri AI. For context, the S5 chip used in the current HomePod mini is the same chip Apple debuted with the Apple Watch Series 5.
Beyond the faster chip, the new HomePod mini 2 will reportedly come in new colors:
Pink
White
Green
Blue
Black
Bonus: New ‘second-party’ smart home gear

Finally, Apple is working with LG on new “second-party” accessories for HomeKit. Apple reportedly collaborated with LG to co-develop products including a smart lock, thermostat, doorbell, and multiple cameras.
Bloomberg says Apple won’t release these accessories for “at least a few more months.” They could still be shown off as part of Apple’s broader home strategy tomorrow, though.
